51:     kind: str
52:     priority: int = 100
53:     status: str = "ready"  # ready | running | done | failed | blocked
54:     retries: int = 0
55:     max_retries: int = 2
56:     payload: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
57:     risk_class: str = "low"
58:     created_at: str = ""
59:     updated_at: str = ""
60:     last_error: str | None = None
61:     result: str | None = None
62: 
63:     @classmethod
64:     def from_dict(cls, row: dict[str, Any]) -> Task:
65:         return cls(
66:             task_id=str(row["task_id"]),
67:             title=str(row.get("title", "")),
68:             kind=str(row["kind"]),
69:             priority=int(row.get("priority", 100)),
70:             status=str(row.get("status", "ready")),
71:             retries=int(row.get("retries", 0)),
72:             max_retries=int(row.get("max_retries", 2)),
73:             payload=dict(row.get("payload") or {}),
74:             risk_class=str(row.get("risk_class", "low")),
75:             created_at=str(row.get("created_at") or _utc()),
76:             updated_at=str(row.get("updated_at") or _utc()),
77:             last_error=row.get("last_error"),
78:             result=row.get("result"),
79:         )
80: 
81:     def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
82:         return asdict(self)
83: 
84: 
85: def ensure_files() -> None:
86:     ensure_sandbox_home()
87:     AGENTIC_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
88:     SANDBOX_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
89:     if not QUEUE_PATH.is_file():
90:         _projection_write(QUEUE_PATH, json.dumps({"tasks": []}, indent=2))
91:     if not STATE_PATH.is_file():
92:         _write_state(
93:             {
94:                 "mode": "normal",
95:                 "heartbeat_at": _utc(),
96:                 "last_task_id": None,
97:                 "last_task_status": None,
98:                 "requires_operator_resume": False,
99:                 "ticks": 0,
100:                 "owner": "viv",
101:             }
102:         )
103: 
104: 
105: def _write_state(state: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
106:     state["updated_at"] = _utc()
107:     _projection_write(STATE_PATH, json.dumps(state, indent=2))
108:     append_event(
109:         {
110:             "event": "runtime_state_snapshot",
111:             "state_sha256": __import__("hashlib").sha256(
112:                 json.dumps(state, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
113:             ).hexdigest(),
114:             "state": dict(state),
115:         }
116:     )
117: 
118: 
119: def load_state() -> dict[str, Any]:
120:     ensure_files()
121:     try:
122:         return json.loads(STATE_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
123:     except (json.JSONDecodeError, OSError):
124:         return {"mode": "degraded", "requires_operator_resume": True}
125: 
126: 
127: def load_queue() -> list[Task]:
128:     ensure_files()
129:     try:
130:         raw = json.loads(QUEUE_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
131:     except (json.JSONDecodeError, OSError):
132:         return []
133:     return [Task.from_dict(row) for row in raw.get("tasks", [])]
134: 
135: 
136: def save_queue(tasks: list[Task]) -> None:
137:     ensure_files()
138:     payload = {"tasks": [t.to_dict() for t in tasks], "updated_at": _utc()}
139:     _projection_write(QUEUE_PATH, json.dumps(payload, indent=2))
140:     append_event(
141:         {
142:             "event": "task_queue_snapshot",
143:             "task_count": len(tasks),
144:             "task_ids": [task.task_id for task in tasks],
145:             "queue_sha256": __import__("hashlib").sha256(
146:                 json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
147:             ).hexdigest(),
148:         }
149:     )
150: 
151: 
152: def append_event(event: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
153:     ensure_files()
154:     event = dict(event)
155:     event.setdefault("timestamp", _utc())
156:     event.setdefault("event_schema", "viv_agentic_runtime_event_v1")
157:     return append_audit_receipt(EVENTS_PATH, event, run_id_prefix="agentic_runtime")
158: 
159: 
160: def _current_s_n() -> float:
161:     try:
162:         return float(load_master_rid().master_s_n)
163:     except Exception:
164:         return 0.0
165: 
166: 
167: def enqueue(
168:     *,
169:     kind: str,
170:     title: str,
171:     payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
172:     priority: int = 100,
173:     risk_class: str = "low",
174:     max_retries: int = 2,
175: ) -> Task:
176:     ensure_files()
177:     task = Task(
178:         task_id=f"t-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]}",
179:         title=title,
180:         kind=kind,
181:         priority=priority,
182:         payload=payload or {},
183:         risk_class=risk_class,
184:         max_retries=max_retries,
185:         created_at=_utc(),
186:         updated_at=_utc(),
187:     )
188:     tasks = load_queue()
189:     tasks.append(task)
190:     save_queue(tasks)
191:     append_event({"event": "enqueued", "task_id": task.task_id, "kind": kind, "title": title})
192:     return task
193: 
194: 
195: def resume(*, operator_authorized: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]:
196:     """Resume only from an explicit operator path; automation cannot self-clear HOLD."""
197:     if not operator_authorized:
198:         return {
199:             "ok": False,
200:             "reason": "operator_authorization_required",
201:             "requires_operator_resume": True,
202:         }
203:     state = load_state()
204:     state["requires_operator_resume"] = False
205:     state["mode"] = "normal"
206:     state["heartbeat_at"] = _utc()
207:     _write_state(state)
208:     append_event({"event": "resumed"})
209:     return {"ok": True, "state": state}
210: 
211: 
212: def needs_resume() -> bool:
213:     return bool(load_state().get("requires_operator_resume"))
214: 
215: 
216: def _autonomy_cfg() -> dict[str, Any]:
217:     try:
218:         from lib.paths import FOUNDATION_ROOT
219: 
220:         raw = json.loads((FOUNDATION_ROOT / "cpu_config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
221:         return dict(raw.get("autonomy") or {})
222:     except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
223:         return {}
224: 
225: 
226: def ensure_cpu_work_queue() -> dict[str, Any]:
227:     """Top up cpu_rid_observe only when the queue has no higher-value operator work."""
228:     cfg = _autonomy_cfg()
229:     if not cfg.get("cpu_rid_autofill", True):
230:         return {"filled": 0, "reason": "autofill_off"}
231:     tasks = load_queue()
232:     ready = [t for t in tasks if t.status == "ready"]
233:     # Never crowd out operator / pillar work with RID spam
234:     operator_kinds = {
235:         "operator_goal",
236:         "speak_brief",
237:         "uml_eval",
238:         "uml_workbook",
239:         "plant_brief",
240:         "memory_append",
241:         "append_journal",
242:         "write_note",
243:         "health_check",
244:         "rid_sample",
245:         "guardian_pulse",
246:         "voice_status",
247:         "memory_retrieve",
248:         "dream_cycle",
249:         "sandbox_code",
250:     }
251:     if any(t.kind in operator_kinds for t in ready):
252:         return {"filled": 0, "reason": "operator_work_pending", "ready": len(ready)}
253:     target = max(0, int(cfg.get("cpu_rid_ready_target") or 1))
254:     settle = float(cfg.get("cpu_rid_settle_s") or 1.5)
255:     ready_cpu = sum(1 for t in ready if t.kind == "cpu_rid_observe")
256:     need = max(0, target - ready_cpu)
257:     added: list[str] = []
258:     for i in range(need):
259:         t = enqueue(
260:             kind="cpu_rid_observe",
261:             title=f"CPU RID hold observe (auto #{i + 1})",
262:             priority=80 + i,
263:             payload={"settle_s": settle},
264:             max_retries=0,
265:         )
266:         added.append(t.task_id)
267:     if added:
268:         append_event({"event": "cpu_rid_autofill", "added": added, "target": target})
269:     return {"filled": len(added), "ready_before": ready_cpu, "target": target, "added": added}
270: 
271: 
272: def _gated_write(path: str, content: str, s_n: float) -> tuple[bool, str, dict[str, Any]]:
273:     target = Path(path)
274:     normalized = str(target.resolve(strict=False)).replace("\\", "/").lower()
275:     if "/sandbox/code/" in normalized or normalized.endswith((".py", ".pyw", ".pyi")):
276:         return False, "raw_code_write_forbidden", {
277:             "allowed": False,
278:             "reason": "raw_code_write_forbidden",
279:             "next": "use_indexed_template_builder",
280:         }
281:     params = {"path": path, "content": content}
282:     try:
283:         context = open_context(
284:             TriadEnvelope.build(
285:                 actor="agentic_runtime",
286:                 source="aios_agent",
287:                 target="filesystem",
288:                 action="AGENTIC_WRITE",
289:                 payload=params,
290:                 s_n=s_n,
291:             )
292:         )
293: 
294:         def _write() -> str:
295:             target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
296:             target.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
297:             return str(target)
298: 
299:         _, receipt = dispatch(
300:             context,
301:             operation="agentic.write",
302:             params=params,
303:             handler=_write,
304:             tool_name="write_file",
305:         )
306:         return True, "write_ok", receipt.to_dict()
307:     except TriadDenied as exc:
308:         verdict = {
309:             "allowed": False,
310:             "reason": exc.reason,
311:             "evidence": exc.evidence,
312:         }
313:         return False, exc.reason, verdict
314: 
315: 
316: def _execute(task: Task, s_n: float) -> tuple[bool, str]:
317:     kind = task.kind
318:     payload = task.payload or {}
319: 
320:     if kind == "noop":
321:         return True, "noop_ok"
322: 
323:     if kind == "health_check":
324:         halt = require_membrane()
325:         if halt:
326:             return False, halt["reason"]
327:         st = membrane_status()
328:         if not st.get("armed"):
329:             return False, "security_membrane_disarmed"
330:         note_path = str(ARTIFACTS_AUTO / "agentic" / "last_health.json").replace("\\", "/")
331:         # Keep payload free of incidental path strings so nested path-smuggle scanners
332:         # do not treat embedded status paths as mutation targets.
333:         body = json.dumps(
334:             {
335:                 "ok": True,
336:                 "armed": st.get("armed"),
337:                 "version": st.get("version"),
338:                 "integrity_ok": (st.get("integrity") or {}).get("ok"),
339:                 "s_n": s_n,
340:                 "at": _utc(),
341:             },
342:             indent=2,
343:         )
344:         ok, reason, _v = _gated_write(note_path, body, s_n)
345:         return ok, reason if ok else reason
346: 
347:     if kind == "write_note":
348:         path = str(payload.get("path") or "").strip()
349:         content = str(payload.get("content") or "")
350:         if not path:
351:             return False, "missing_path"
352:         ok, reason, _v = _gated_write(path, content, s_n)
353:         return ok, reason
354: 
355:     if kind == "append_journal":
356:         # Write a unique note under sandbox (append via rewrite after gate on same path)
357:         path = str(
358:             payload.get("path")
359:             or (JOURNAL / "agent_journal.txt")
360:         ).replace("\\", "/")
361:         line = str(payload.get("line") or f"[{_utc()}] agent tick")
362:         existing = ""
363:         p = Path(path)
364:         if p.is_file():
365:             existing = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
366:         content = existing + line.rstrip() + "\n"
367:         ok, reason, _v = _gated_write(path, content, s_n)
368:         return ok, reason
369: 
370:     if kind == "memory_append":
371:         text = str(payload.get("text") or "").strip()
372:         if not text:
373:             return False, "missing_text"
374:         try:
375:             from lib.carma_memory import remember
376: 
377:             prov = str(payload.get("provenance") or "live")
378:             tags = payload.get("tags") or []
379:             if isinstance(tags, str):
380:                 tags = [t.strip() for t in tags.split(",") if t.strip()]
381:             out = remember(text, provenance=prov, tags=tags, s_n=s_n)
382:             return bool(out.get("ok")), str(out.get("reason") or out.get("id") or "memory_ok")
383:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
384:             return False, f"memory_append_error:{exc}"
385: 
386:     if kind == "memory_retrieve":
387:         query = str(payload.get("query") or "").strip()
388:         if not query:
389:             return False, "missing_query"
390:         try:
391:             from lib.carma_memory import retrieve
392: 
393:             top = int(payload.get("top") or 5)
394:             hits = retrieve(query, top=top)
395:             return True, json.dumps({"hits": hits, "count": len(hits)})
396:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
397:             return False, f"memory_retrieve_error:{exc}"
398: 
399:     if kind == "cpu_core_probe":
400:         core_id = str(payload.get("core_id") or "").strip()
401:         operation = str(payload.get("operation") or "status").strip().casefold()
402:         if not core_id:
403:             return False, "missing_core_id"
404:         try:
405:             from lib.cpu_core_dispatch import probe
406: 
407:             result = probe(core_id, operation=operation)
408:             if result.get("state") == "DENIED":
409:                 return False, str(result.get("reason") or "cpu_core_probe_denied")
410:             return result.get("state") == "PASS", json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, default=str)
411:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
412:             return False, f"cpu_core_probe_error:{exc}"
413: 
414:     if kind == "cpu_core_survey":
415:         try:
416:             from lib.cpu_core_dispatch import available_cores, probe_many
417: 
418:             result = probe_many(available_cores(), operation="status")
419:             return result.get("ok") is True, json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, default=str)
420:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
421:             return False, f"cpu_core_survey_error:{exc}"
422: 
423:     if kind == "cpu_reasoning_probe":
424:         value = payload.get("value")
425:         if value is None:
426:             return False, "missing_reasoning_input"
427:         try:
428:             from lib.cpu_reasoning_pipeline import compact, reason
429: 
430:             result = reason(
431:                 value,
432:                 s_n=s_n,
433:                 manual_only=bool(payload.get("manual_only", False)),
434:                 local_wikipedia=bool(payload.get("local_wikipedia", True)),
435:                 top_k=int(payload.get("top_k") or 5),
436:             )
437:             if result.get("state") == "DENIED":
438:                 return False, compact(result)
439:             return True, compact(result)
440:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
441:             return False, f"cpu_reasoning_probe_error:{exc}"
442: 
443:     if kind == "cpu_choice_simulation":
444:         try:
445:             from lib.cpu_choice_simulator import simulate_choices, simulate_state_choices
446: 
447:             oracle = payload.get("oracle_actions") or []
448:             choices = payload.get("choices") or []
449:             states = payload.get("states") or []
450:             if states:
451:                 result = simulate_state_choices(states, choices, max_steps=int(payload.get("max_steps") or 256))
452:             else:
453:                 result = simulate_choices(oracle, choices, max_steps=int(payload.get("max_steps") or 256))
454:             return result.get("ok") is True, json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, default=str)
455:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
456:             return False, f"cpu_choice_simulation_error:{exc}"
457: 
458:     if kind == "cpu_choice_live_probe":
459:         try:
460:             from lib.cpu_choice_simulator import evaluate_candidates
461:             from lib.cpu_action_contract import build_contract, make_receipt, verify_contract
462:             from lib.cpu_state_snapshot import capture_live
463: 
464:             snapshot = capture_live()
465:             result = evaluate_candidates(snapshot)
466:             contract = build_contract(task_id=task.task_id, action=result["reference_action"], state=snapshot)
467:             verification = verify_contract(contract, snapshot)
468:             result["contract"] = contract
469:             result["verification"] = verification
470:             result["receipt"] = make_receipt(contract, verification)
471:             result["ok"] = bool(result.get("ok")) and bool(verification.get("ok"))
472:             return result.get("ok") is True, json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, default=str)
473:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
474:             return False, f"cpu_choice_live_probe_error:{exc}"
475: 
476:     if kind == "cpu_cleanup_plan":
477:         try:
478:             from lib.cpu_cleanup_planner import build_plan
479: 
480:             result = build_plan(payload.get("candidates") or [])
481:             return result.get("ok") is True, json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, default=str)
482:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
483:             return False, f"cpu_cleanup_plan_error:{exc}"
484: 
485:     if kind == "cpu_rid_shadow_probe":
486:         try:
487:             from lib.rid_recursive_shadow import probe
488: 
489:             result = probe(payload)
490:             return result.get("ok") is True, json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, default=str)
491:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
492:             return False, f"cpu_rid_shadow_probe_error:{exc}"
493: 
494:     if kind == "cpu_sandbox_probe":
495:         try:
496:             from lib.cpu_sandbox_boundary import evaluate_request
497: 
498:             result = evaluate_request(payload)
499:             return result.get("ok") is True, json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, default=str)
500:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
501:             return False, f"cpu_sandbox_probe_error:{exc}"
502: 
503:     if kind == "cpu_infra_probe":
504:         try:
505:             from lib.cpu_infra_ops_judge import build_probe
506: 
507:             result = build_probe(payload)
508:             return result.get("ok") is True, json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, default=str)
509:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
510:             return False, f"cpu_infra_probe_error:{exc}"
511: 
512:     if kind == "cpu_enterprise_probe":
513:         try:
514:             from lib.cpu_enterprise_policy import probe
515: 
516:             result = probe(payload)
517:             return result.get("ok") is True, json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, default=str)
518:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
519:             return False, f"cpu_enterprise_probe_error:{exc}"
520: 
521:     if kind == "cpu_action_execute":
522:         try:
523:             from lib.cpu_action_executor import execute_contract
524:             from lib.cpu_state_snapshot import capture_live
525: 
526:             contract = payload.get("contract")
527:             if not isinstance(contract, dict):
528:                 return False, "missing_action_contract"
529:             result = execute_contract(contract, capture_live())
530:             return result.get("ok") is True, json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, default=str)
531:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
532:             return False, f"cpu_action_execute_error:{exc}"
533: 
534:     if kind == "cpu_rid_observe":
535:         # CPU-first teach tick — plant grades hold prediction; no GPU.
536:         try:
537:             from lib.cpu_rid_tick import rid_cpu_tick
538: 
539:             settle = float(payload.get("settle_s") or 1.5)
540:             out = rid_cpu_tick(settle_s=settle)
541:             # Observation success = cycle ran; PUNISH/NEUTRAL are grades, not executor faults.
542:             ok = bool(out.get("ok")) and not bool(out.get("excluded"))
543:             return ok, json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False)
544:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
545:             return False, f"cpu_rid_observe_error:{exc}"
546: 
547:     if kind == "uml_eval":
548:         expr = str(payload.get("expr") or "[3,4]").strip()
549:         try:
550:             from lib.uml_engine import evaluate, fmt, to_std, to_uml, verify
551: 
552:             result, node, nota, _ = evaluate(expr)
553:             alt = to_std(node) if nota == "uml" else to_uml(node)
554:             ok_v, report_v = verify(expr)
555:             body = {
556:                 "expr": expr,
557:                 "result": fmt(result),
558:                 "notation": nota,
559:                 "alt": alt,
560:                 "verify_ok": bool(ok_v),
561:                 "verify_report": report_v,
562:                 "at": _utc(),
563:             }
564:             note_path = str(ARTIFACTS_AUTO / "agentic" / "last_uml.json").replace("\\", "/")
565:             ok, reason, _v = _gated_write(note_path, json.dumps(body, indent=2), s_n)
566:             if not ok:
567:                 return False, reason
568:             return bool(ok_v), json.dumps(body, ensure_ascii=False)
569:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
570:             return False, f"uml_eval_error:{exc}"
571: 
572:     if kind == "rid_sample":
573:         try:
574:             from lib.master_rid import compute_master_rid, publish_master_rid
575:             from lib.rid_feed import pulse_once
576: 
577:             sample = pulse_once()
578:             master = compute_master_rid(sample)
579:             publish_master_rid(master)
580:             body = {
581:                 "master_s_n": master.master_s_n,
582:                 "status": master.status,
583:                 "rsr": master.master_rsr,
584:                 "ltp": master.master_ltp,
585:                 "rle": master.master_rle,
586:                 "at": _utc(),
587:             }
588:             note_path = str(ARTIFACTS_AUTO / "agentic" / "last_rid_sample.json").replace("\\", "/")
589:             ok, reason, _v = _gated_write(note_path, json.dumps(body, indent=2), s_n)
590:             return ok, reason if ok else reason
591:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
592:             return False, f"rid_sample_error:{exc}"
593: 
594:     if kind == "guardian_pulse":
595:         text = str(payload.get("text") or "Master S_n plant status ACTIVE").strip()
596:         try:
597:             from lib.guardian_v2 import evaluate_guardian
598: 
599:             g = evaluate_guardian(text, s_n=s_n)
600:             body = g.to_dict() if hasattr(g, "to_dict") else dict(g)
601:             note_path = str(ARTIFACTS_AUTO / "agentic" / "last_guardian.json").replace("\\", "/")
602:             ok, reason, _v = _gated_write(note_path, json.dumps(body, indent=2, default=str), s_n)
603:             if not ok:
604:                 return False, reason
605:             # Curriculum pulse: recording the verdict is success; block is informational.
606:             return True, json.dumps(
607:                 {"allowed": bool(body.get("allowed")), "stage": body.get("stage"), "at": _utc()},
608:                 ensure_ascii=False,
609:             )
610:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
611:             return False, f"guardian_pulse_error:{exc}"
612: 
613:     if kind == "voice_status":
614:         try:
615:             from voice_core.speak import speak_status
616:

782: def run_once(max_tasks: int = 1) -> dict[str, Any]:
783:     """Process up to max_tasks ready items. Returns structured tick report."""
784:     ensure_files()
785:     state = load_state()
786:     report: dict[str, Any] = {
787:         "ok": True,
788:         "owner": "viv",
789:         "processed": [],
790:         "skipped": None,
791:     }
792: 
793:     halt = require_membrane()
794:     if halt:
795:         report["ok"] = False
796:         report["skipped"] = {"reason": "security_membrane", "detail": halt}
797:         state["mode"] = "halted"
798:         state["requires_operator_resume"] = True
799:         _write_state(state)
800:         append_event({"event": "tick_halted", "reason": halt})
801:         return report
802: 
803:     if state.get("requires_operator_resume"):
804:         report["ok"] = False
805:         report["skipped"] = {"reason": "requires_operator_resume"}
806:         append_event({"event": "tick_paused"})
807:         return report
808: 
809:     s_n = _current_s_n()
810:     try:
811:         from lib.paths import FOUNDATION_ROOT
812: 
813:         raw = json.loads((FOUNDATION_ROOT / "cpu_config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
814:         dormancy = float(raw.get("dormancy_threshold") or 0.37)
815:     except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError, ValueError):
816:         dormancy = 0.37
817:     if s_n < dormancy:
818:         report["ok"] = False
819:         report["skipped"] = {"reason": "dormant", "s_n": s_n, "floor": dormancy}
820:         append_event({"event": "tick_dormant", "s_n": s_n, "floor": dormancy})
821:         state["heartbeat_at"] = _utc()
822:         state["mode"] = "degraded"
823:         _write_state(state)
824:         return report
825: 
826:     tasks = load_queue()
827:     ready = sorted(
828:         [t for t in tasks if t.status == "ready"],
829:         key=lambda t: (t.priority, t.created_at),
830:     )
831:     budget = max(1, int(max_tasks))
832:     taken = ready[:budget]
833: 
834:     if not taken:
835:         # Autofill CPU RID work then retry once so empty queue does not idle forever.
836:         fill = ensure_cpu_work_queue()
837:         report["autofill"] = fill
838:         if fill.get("filled"):
839:             tasks = load_queue()
840:             ready = sorted(
841:                 [t for t in tasks if t.status == "ready"],
842:                 key=lambda t: (t.priority, t.created_at),
843:             )
844:             taken = ready[:budget]
845:         if not taken:
846:             report["skipped"] = {"reason": "empty_queue"}
847:             state["heartbeat_at"] = _utc()
848:             state["ticks"] = int(state.get("ticks") or 0) + 1
849:             state["mode"] = "normal"
850:             _write_state(state)
851:             append_event({"event": "tick_idle", "s_n": s_n})
852:             return report
853: 
854:     for task in taken:
855:         task.status = "running"
856:         task.updated_at = _utc()
857:         save_queue(tasks)
858:         append_event({"event": "task_start", "task_id": task.task_id, "kind": task.kind, "s_n": s_n})
859: 
860:         ok, reason = _execute(task, s_n)
861:         task.updated_at = _utc()
862:         task.result = reason
863:         if ok:
864:             task.status = "done"
865:             task.last_error = None
866:         else:
867:             task.retries += 1
868:             task.last_error = reason
869:             denial_reason = str(reason).casefold()
870:             if (
871:                 "law" in denial_reason
872:                 or "security" in denial_reason
873:                 or "tool_gate" in denial_reason
874:                 or "sandbox" in denial_reason
875:             ):
876:                 task.status = "blocked"
877:             elif task.retries > task.max_retries:
878:                 task.status = "failed"
879:             else:
880:                 task.status = "ready"
881:         save_queue(tasks)
882:         append_event(
883:             {
884:                 "event": "task_finish",
885:                 "task_id": task.task_id,
886:                 "kind": task.kind,
887:                 "ok": ok,
888:                 "status": task.status,
889:                 "reason": reason,
890:                 "s_n": s_n,
891:             }
892:         )
893:         report["processed"].append(
894:             {
895:                 "task_id": task.task_id,
896:                 "kind": task.kind,
897:                 "ok": ok,
898:                 "status": task.status,
899:                 "reason": reason,
900:             }
901:         )
902:         state["last_task_id"] = task.task_id
903:         state["last_task_status"] = task.status
904: 
905:     state["heartbeat_at"] = _utc()
906:     state["ticks"] = int(state.get("ticks") or 0) + 1
907:     state["mode"] = "normal"
908:     _write_state(state)
909:     report["s_n"] = s_n
910:     report["exit_code"] = 0 if report["ok"] else 1
911:     return report
912:

914: def status() -> dict[str, Any]:

917:     by = {}

920:     return {
921:         "owner": "viv",
922:         "queue_path": str(QUEUE_PATH),
923:         "state": load_state(),
924:         "counts": by,
925:         "tasks": len(tasks),
926:         "security": membrane_status(),
927:         "events_path": str(EVENTS_PATH),
928:     }

249:         "sandbox_code",
250:     }
251:     if any(t.kind in operator_kinds for t in ready):
252:         return {"filled": 0, "reason": "operator_work_pending", "ready": len(ready)}
253:     target = max(0, int(cfg.get("cpu_rid_ready_target") or 1))
254:     settle = float(cfg.get("cpu_rid_settle_s") or 1.5)
255:     ready_cpu = sum(1 for t in ready if t.kind == "cpu_rid_observe")
256:     need = max(0, target - ready_cpu)
257:     added: list[str] = []
258:     for i in range(need):
259:         t = enqueue(
260:             kind="cpu_rid_observe",
261:             title=f"CPU RID hold observe (auto #{i + 1})",
262:             priority=80 + i,
263:             payload={"settle_s": settle},
264:             max_retries=0,
265:         )
266:         added.append(t.task_id)
267:     if added:
268:         append_event({"event": "cpu_rid_autofill", "added": added, "target": target})
269:     return {"filled": len(added), "ready_before": ready_cpu, "target": target, "added": added}
270: 
271: 
272: def _gated_write(path: str, content: str, s_n: float) -> tuple[bool, str, dict[str, Any]]:
273:     target = Path(path)
274:     normalized = str(target.resolve(strict=False)).replace("\\", "/").lower()
275:     if "/sandbox/code/" in normalized or normalized.endswith((".py", ".pyw", ".pyi")):
276:         return False, "raw_code_write_forbidden", {
277:             "allowed": False,
278:             "reason": "raw_code_write_forbidden",
279:             "next": "use_indexed_template_builder",
280:         }
281:     params = {"path": path, "content": content}
282:     try:
283:         context = open_context(
284:             TriadEnvelope.build(
285:                 actor="agentic_runtime",
286:                 source="aios_agent",
287:                 target="filesystem",
288:                 action="AGENTIC_WRITE",
289:                 payload=params,
290:                 s_n=s_n,
291:             )
292:         )
293: 
294:         def _write() -> str:
295:             target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
296:             target.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
297:             return str(target)
298: 
299:         _, receipt = dispatch(
300:             context,
301:             operation="agentic.write",
302:             params=params,
303:             handler=_write,
304:             tool_name="write_file",
305:         )
306:         return True, "write_ok", receipt.to_dict()
307:     except TriadDenied as exc:
308:         verdict = {
309:             "allowed": False,
310:             "reason": exc.reason,
311:             "evidence": exc.evidence,
312:         }
313:         return False, exc.reason, verdict
314: 
315: 
316: def _execute(task: Task, s_n: float) -> tuple[bool, str]:
317:     kind = task.kind
318:     payload = task.payload or {}
319: 
320:     if kind == "noop":
321:         return True, "noop_ok"
322: 
323:     if kind == "health_check":
324:         halt = require_membrane()
325:         if halt:
326:             return False, halt["reason"]
327:         st = membrane_status()
328:         if not st.get("armed"):
329:             return False, "security_membrane_disarmed"
330:         note_path = str(ARTIFACTS_AUTO / "agentic" / "last_health.json").replace("\\", "/")
331:         # Keep payload free of incidental path strings so nested path-smuggle scanners
332:         # do not treat embedded status paths as mutation targets.
333:         body = json.dumps(
334:             {
335:                 "ok": True,
336:                 "armed": st.get("armed"),
337:                 "version": st.get("version"),
338:                 "integrity_ok": (st.get("integrity") or {}).get("ok"),
339:                 "s_n": s_n,
340:                 "at": _utc(),
341:             },
342:             indent=2,
343:         )
344:         ok, reason, _v = _gated_write(note_path, body, s_n)
345:         return ok, reason if ok else reason
346: 
347:     if kind == "write_note":
348:         path = str(payload.get("path") or "").strip()
349:         content = str(payload.get("content") or "")
350:         if not path:
351:             return False, "missing_path"
352:         ok, reason, _v = _gated_write(path, content, s_n)
353:         return ok, reason
354: 
355:     if kind == "append_journal":
356:         # Write a unique note under sandbox (append via rewrite after gate on same path)
357:         path = str(
358:             payload.get("path")
359:             or (JOURNAL / "agent_journal.txt")
360:         ).replace("\\", "/")
361:         line = str(payload.get("line") or f"[{_utc()}] agent tick")
362:         existing = ""
363:         p = Path(path)
364:         if p.is_file():
365:             existing = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
366:         content = existing + line.rstrip() + "\n"
367:         ok, reason, _v = _gated_write(path, content, s_n)
368:         return ok, reason
369: 
370:     if kind == "memory_append":
371:         text = str(payload.get("text") or "").strip()
372:         if not text:
373:             return False, "missing_text"
374:         try:
375:             from lib.carma_memory import remember
376: 
377:             prov = str(payload.get("provenance") or "live")
378:             tags = payload.get("tags") or []
379:             if isinstance(tags, str):
380:                 tags = [t.strip() for t in tags.split(",") if t.strip()]
381:             out = remember(text, provenance=prov, tags=tags, s_n=s_n)
382:             return bool(out.get("ok")), str(out.get("reason") or out.get("id") or "memory_ok")
383:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
384:             return False, f"memory_append_error:{exc}"
385: 
386:     if kind == "memory_retrieve":
387:         query = str(payload.get("query") or "").strip()
388:         if not query:
389:             return False, "missing_query"
390:         try:
391:             from lib.carma_memory import retrieve
392: 
393:             top = int(payload.get("top") or 5)
394:             hits = retrieve(query, top=top)
395:             return True, json.dumps({"hits": hits, "count": len(hits)})
396:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
397:             return False, f"memory_retrieve_error:{exc}"
398: 
399:     if kind == "cpu_core_probe":
400:         core_id = str(payload.get("core_id") or "").strip()
401:         operation = str(payload.get("operation") or "status").strip().casefold()
402:         if not core_id:
403:             return False, "missing_core_id"
404:         try:
405:             from lib.cpu_core_dispatch import probe
406: 
407:             result = probe(core_id, operation=operation)
408:             if result.get("state") == "DENIED":
409:                 return False, str(result.get("reason") or "cpu_core_probe_denied")
410:             return result.get("state") == "PASS", json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, default=str)
411:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
412:             return False, f"cpu_core_probe_error:{exc}"
413: 
414:     if kind == "cpu_core_survey":
415:         try:
416:             from lib.cpu_core_dispatch import available_cores, probe_many
417: 
418:             result = probe_many(available_cores(), operation="status")
419:             return result.get("ok") is True, json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, default=str)
420:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
421:             return False, f"cpu_core_survey_error:{exc}"
422: 
423:     if kind == "cpu_reasoning_probe":
424:         value = payload.get("value")
425:         if value is None:
426:             return False, "missing_reasoning_input"
427:         try:
428:             from lib.cpu_reasoning_pipeline import compact, reason
429: 
430:             result = reason(
431:                 value,
432:                 s_n=s_n,
433:                 manual_only=bool(payload.get("manual_only", False)),
434:                 local_wikipedia=bool(payload.get("local_wikipedia", True)),
435:                 top_k=int(payload.get("top_k") or 5),
436:             )
437:             if result.get("state") == "DENIED":
438:                 return False, compact(result)
439:             return True, compact(result)
440:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
441:             return False, f"cpu_reasoning_probe_error:{exc}"
442: 
443:     if kind == "cpu_choice_simulation":
444:         try:
445:             from lib.cpu_choice_simulator import simulate_choices, simulate_state_choices
446: 
447:             oracle = payload.get("oracle_actions") or []
448:             choices = payload.get("choices") or []
449:             states = payload.get("states") or []
450:             if states:
451:                 result = simulate_state_choices(states, choices, max_steps=int(payload.get("max_steps") or 256))
452:             else:
453:                 result = simulate_choices(oracle, choices, max_steps=int(payload.get("max_steps") or 256))
454:             return result.get("ok") is True, json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, default=str)
455:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
456:             return False, f"cpu_choice_simulation_error:{exc}"
457: 
458:     if kind == "cpu_choice_live_probe":
459:         try:
460:             from lib.cpu_choice_simulator import evaluate_candidates
461:             from lib.cpu_action_contract import build_contract, make_receipt, verify_contract
462:             from lib.cpu_state_snapshot import capture_live
463: 
464:             snapshot = capture_live()
465:             result = evaluate_candidates(snapshot)
466:             contract = build_contract(task_id=task.task_id, action=result["reference_action"], state=snapshot)
467:             verification = verify_contract(contract, snapshot)
468:             result["contract"] = contract
469:             result["verification"] = verification
470:             result["receipt"] = make_receipt(contract, verification)
471:             result["ok"] = bool(result.get("ok")) and bool(verification.get("ok"))
472:             return result.get("ok") is True, json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, default=str)
473:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
474:             return False, f"cpu_choice_live_probe_error:{exc}"
475: 
476:     if kind == "cpu_cleanup_plan":
477:         try:
478:             from lib.cpu_cleanup_planner import build_plan
479: 
480:             result = build_plan(payload.get("candidates") or [])
481:             return result.get("ok") is True, json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, default=str)
482:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
483:             return False, f"cpu_cleanup_plan_error:{exc}"
484: 
485:     if kind == "cpu_rid_shadow_probe":
486:         try:
487:             from lib.rid_recursive_shadow import probe
488: 
489:             result = probe(payload)
490:             return result.get("ok") is True, json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, default=str)
491:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
492:             return False, f"cpu_rid_shadow_probe_error:{exc}"
493: 
494:     if kind == "cpu_sandbox_probe":
495:         try:
496:             from lib.cpu_sandbox_boundary import evaluate_request
497: 
498:             result = evaluate_request(payload)
499:             return result.get("ok") is True, json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, default=str)
500:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
501:             return False, f"cpu_sandbox_probe_error:{exc}"
502: 
503:     if kind == "cpu_infra_probe":
504:         try:
505:             from lib.cpu_infra_ops_judge import build_probe
506: 
507:             result = build_probe(payload)
508:             return result.get("ok") is True, json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, default=str)
509:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
510:             return False, f"cpu_infra_probe_error:{exc}"
511: 
512:     if kind == "cpu_enterprise_probe":
513:         try:
514:             from lib.cpu_enterprise_policy import probe
515: 
516:             result = probe(payload)
517:             return result.get("ok") is True, json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, default=str)
518:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
519:             return False, f"cpu_enterprise_probe_error:{exc}"
520: 
521:     if kind == "cpu_action_execute":
522:         try:
523:             from lib.cpu_action_executor import execute_contract

525: 
526:             contract = payload.get("contract")
527:             if not isinstance(contract, dict):
528:                 return False, "missing_action_contract"
529:             result = execute_contract(contract, capture_live())
530:             return result.get("ok") is True, json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, default=str)
531:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
532:             return False, f"cpu_action_execute_error:{exc}"

534:     if kind == "cpu_rid_observe":
535:         # CPU-first teach tick — plant grades hold prediction; no GPU.

537:             from lib.cpu_rid_tick import rid_cpu_tick
538: 
539:             settle = float(payload.get("settle_s") or 1.5)
540:             out = rid_cpu_tick(settle_s=settle)
541:             # Observation success = cycle ran; PUNISH/NEUTRAL are grades, not executor faults.
542:             ok = bool(out.get("ok")) and not bool(out.get("excluded"))
543:             return ok, json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False)
544:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
545:             return False, f"cpu_rid_observe_error:{exc}"

547:     if kind == "uml_eval":
548:         expr = str(payload.get("expr") or "[3,4]").strip()

552:             result, node, nota, _ = evaluate(expr)
553:             alt = to_std(node) if nota == "uml" else to_uml(node)
554:             ok_v, report_v = verify(expr)
555:             body = {
556:                 "expr": expr,
557:                 "result": fmt(result),
558:                 "notation": nota,
559:                 "alt": alt,
560:                 "verify_ok": bool(ok_v),
561:                 "verify_report": report_v,
562:                 "at": _utc(),
563:             }
564:             note_path = str(ARTIFACTS_AUTO / "agentic" / "last_uml.json").replace("\\", "/")
565:             ok, reason, _v = _gated_write(note_path, json.dumps(body, indent=2), s_n)
566:             if not ok:
567:                 return False, reason
568:             return bool(ok_v), json.dumps(body, ensure_ascii=False)
569:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
570:             return False, f"uml_eval_error:{exc}"

572:     if kind == "rid_sample":

574:             from lib.master_rid import compute_master_rid, publish_master_rid

579:             publish_master_rid(master)
580:             body = {
581:                 "master_s_n": master.master_s_n,
582:                 "status": master.status,
583:                 "rsr": master.master_rsr,
584:                 "ltp": master.master_ltp,
585:                 "rle": master.master_rle,
586:                 "at": _utc(),
587:             }
588:             note_path = str(ARTIFACTS_AUTO / "agentic" / "last_rid_sample.json").replace("\\", "/")
589:             ok, reason, _v = _gated_write(note_path, json.dumps(body, indent=2), s_n)
590:             return ok, reason if ok else reason
591:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
592:             return False, f"rid_sample_error:{exc}"
593: 
594:     if kind == "guardian_pulse":
595:         text = str(payload.get("text") or "Master S_n plant status ACTIVE").strip()
596:         try:
597:             from lib.guardian_v2 import evaluate_guardian
598: 
599:             g = evaluate_guardian(text, s_n=s_n)
600:             body = g.to_dict() if hasattr(g, "to_dict") else dict(g)
601:             note_path = str(ARTIFACTS_AUTO / "agentic" / "last_guardian.json").replace("\\", "/")
602:             ok, reason, _v = _gated_write(note_path, json.dumps(body, indent=2, default=str), s_n)
603:             if not ok:
604:                 return False, reason
605:             # Curriculum pulse: recording the verdict is success; block is informational.
606:             return True, json.dumps(
607:                 {"allowed": bool(body.get("allowed")), "stage": body.get("stage"), "at": _utc()},
608:                 ensure_ascii=False,
609:             )
610:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
611:             return False, f"guardian_pulse_error:{exc}"
612: 
613:     if kind == "voice_status":
614:         try:
615:             from voice_core.speak import speak_status
616: 
617:             st = speak_status()
618:             body = {
619:                 "backend": st.get("backend"),
620:                 "served_name": st.get("served_name"),
621:                 "reachable": st.get("reachable"),
622:                 "gguf_ready": (st.get("gguf") or {}).get("gguf_ready"),
623:                 "at": _utc(),
624:             }

626:             ok, reason, _v = _gated_write(note_path, json.dumps(body, indent=2), s_n)
627:             return ok and bool(st.get("reachable") or (st.get("gguf") or {}).get("gguf_ready")), (
628:                 reason if ok else reason

630:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
631:             return False, f"voice_status_error:{exc}"
632: 
633:     if kind == "speak_brief":

641:                 "source": sp.get("voice_source"),

643:                 "query": query,
644:                 "at": _utc(),
645:             }
646:             note_path = str(ARTIFACTS_AUTO / "agentic" / "last_speak.json").replace("\\", "/")
647:             ok, reason, _v = _gated_write(note_path, json.dumps(body, indent=2, default=str), s_n)
648:             if not ok:
649:                 return False, reason
650:             return bool(sp.get("text")), json.dumps(
651:                 {"source": body.get("source"), "chars": len(str(body.get("text") or ""))},
652:                 ensure_ascii=False,
653:             )
654:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
655:             return False, f"speak_brief_error:{exc}"
656: 
657:     if kind == "plant_brief":
658:         try:
659:             from lib.master_rid import load_master_rid
660: 
661:             m = load_master_rid()
662:             text = (
663:                 f"[{_utc()}] Plant brief — Master S_n={m.master_s_n:.4f} status={m.status} "
664:                 f"RSR={m.master_rsr:.4f} LTP={m.master_ltp:.4f} RLE={m.master_rle:.4f}\n"
665:             )
666:             path = str((WORK / "plant_brief.txt")).replace("\\", "/")
667:             # append via rewrite
668:             existing = ""
669:             p = Path(path)
670:             if p.is_file():
671:                 existing = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
672:             ok, reason, _v = _gated_write(path, existing + text, s_n)
673:             return ok, reason if ok else reason
674:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
675:             return False, f"plant_brief_error:{exc}"
676: 
677:     if kind == "operator_goal":
678:         goal = str(payload.get("goal") or "").strip()
679:         if not goal:
680:             return False, "missing_goal"
681:         try:
682:             plan = (
683:                 f"[{_utc()}] OPERATOR GOAL\n"
684:                 f"goal: {goal}\n"
685:                 f"s_n: {s_n:.4f}\n"
686:                 f"plan:\n"
687:                 f"  1) measure plant (RID)\n"
688:                 f"  2) remember goal in CARMA\n"
689:                 f"  3) write sandbox note\n"
690:                 f"  4) report on task board / outbox\n"
691:             )
692:             path = str((OPERATOR / "goals.txt")).replace("\\", "/")
693:             existing = ""
694:             p = Path(path)
695:             if p.is_file():
696:                 existing = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
697:             ok, reason, _v = _gated_write(path, existing + plan + "\n", s_n)
698:             if not ok:
699:                 return False, reason
700:             try:
701:                 from lib.carma_memory import remember
702: 
703:                 remember(f"[goal] {goal}", provenance="operator", tags=["goal", "operator"], s_n=s_n)
704:             except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
705:                 pass
706:             return True, "goal_recorded"
707:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
708:             return False, f"operator_goal_error:{exc}"
709: 
710:     if kind == "uml_workbook":
711:         n = max(1, min(5, int(payload.get("n") or 3)))
712:         exprs = ["[3,4]", "{10,3}", ">3,4<", "[1,>2,3<]", "%[10,3]"][:n]
713:         try:
714:             from lib.uml_engine import evaluate, fmt, verify
715: 
716:             rows = []
717:             for expr in exprs:
718:                 result, _node, nota, _ = evaluate(expr)
719:                 ok_v, _rep = verify(expr)
720:                 rows.append({"expr": expr, "result": fmt(result), "notation": nota, "ok": bool(ok_v)})
721:             body = {"at": _utc(), "rows": rows}
722:             path = str((WORK / "uml_workbook.txt")).replace("\\", "/")
723:             lines = [f"[{body['at']}] UML workbook"] + [
724:                 f"  {r['expr']} => {r['result']} ({'ok' if r['ok'] else 'fail'})" for r in rows
725:             ]
726:             existing = ""
727:             p = Path(path)
728:             if p.is_file():
729:                 existing = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
730:             ok, reason, _v = _gated_write(path, existing + "\n".join(lines) + "\n\n", s_n)
731:             if not ok:
732:                 return False, reason
733:             note_path = str(ARTIFACTS_AUTO / "agentic" / "last_uml_workbook.json").replace("\\", "/")
734:             _gated_write(note_path, json.dumps(body, indent=2), s_n)
735:             return all(r["ok"] for r in rows), json.dumps({"n": len(rows), "ok": True})
736:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
737:             return False, f"uml_workbook_error:{exc}"
738: 
739:     if kind == "dream_cycle":
740:         try:
741:             from lib.aios_dream import perform_dream_cycle

745:             _gated_write(note_path, json.dumps(out, indent=2, default=str), s_n)
746:             if out.get("skipped"):
747:                 return True, json.dumps({"skipped": out.get("skipped"), "s_n": out.get("s_n")})
748:             return bool(out.get("ok")), json.dumps(
749:                 {
750:                     "cycle": out.get("cycle"),
751:                     "dream_path": out.get("dream_path"),
752:                     "live_chars": out.get("live_chars"),
753:                 },
754:                 ensure_ascii=False,
755:             )
756:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
757:             return False, f"dream_cycle_error:{exc}"
758: 
759:     if kind == "sandbox_code":
760:         try:
761:             from lib.aios_coder import write_and_run
762: 
763:             tool = payload.get("tool")
764:             out = write_and_run(tool=str(tool) if tool else None)
765:             note_path = str(ARTIFACTS_AUTO / "agentic" / "last_sandbox_code.json").replace("\\", "/")
766:             _gated_write(note_path, json.dumps(out, indent=2, default=str), s_n)
767:             run = out.get("run") or {}
768:             return bool(out.get("ok")), json.dumps(
769:                 {

771:                     "stdout": (run.get("stdout") or "")[:200],

773:                 },

782: def run_once(max_tasks: int = 1) -> dict[str, Any]:
783:     """Process up to max_tasks ready items. Returns structured tick report."""
784:     ensure_files()
785:     state = load_state()
786:     report: dict[str, Any] = {
787:         "ok": True,
788:         "owner": "viv",
789:         "processed": [],
790:         "skipped": None,
791:     }
792: 
793:     halt = require_membrane()
794:     if halt:
795:         report["ok"] = False
796:         report["skipped"] = {"reason": "security_membrane", "detail": halt}
797:         state["mode"] = "halted"
798:         state["requires_operator_resume"] = True
799:         _write_state(state)
800:         append_event({"event": "tick_halted", "reason": halt})
801:         return report
802: 
803:     if state.get("requires_operator_resume"):
804:         report["ok"] = False
805:         report["skipped"] = {"reason": "requires_operator_resume"}
806:         append_event({"event": "tick_paused"})
807:         return report
808: 
809:     s_n = _current_s_n()
810:     try:
811:         from lib.paths import FOUNDATION_ROOT
812: 
813:         raw = json.loads((FOUNDATION_ROOT / "cpu_config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
814:         dormancy = float(raw.get("dormancy_threshold") or 0.37)
815:     except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError, ValueError):
816:         dormancy = 0.37
817:     if s_n < dormancy:
818:         report["ok"] = False
819:         report["skipped"] = {"reason": "dormant", "s_n": s_n, "floor": dormancy}
820:         append_event({"event": "tick_dormant", "s_n": s_n, "floor": dormancy})
821:         state["heartbeat_at"] = _utc()
822:         state["mode"] = "degraded"
823:         _write_state(state)
824:         return report
825: 
826:     tasks = load_queue()
827:     ready = sorted(
828:         [t for t in tasks if t.status == "ready"],
829:         key=lambda t: (t.priority, t.created_at),
830:     )
831:     budget = max(1, int(max_tasks))
832:     taken = ready[:budget]
833: 
834:     if not taken:
835:         # Autofill CPU RID work then retry once so empty queue does not idle forever.
836:         fill = ensure_cpu_work_queue()
837:         report["autofill"] = fill
838:         if fill.get("filled"):
839:             tasks = load_queue()
840:             ready = sorted(
841:                 [t for t in tasks if t.status == "ready"],
842:                 key=lambda t: (t.priority, t.created_at),
843:             )
844:             taken = ready[:budget]
845:         if not taken:
846:             report["skipped"] = {"reason": "empty_queue"}
847:             state["heartbeat_at"] = _utc()
848:             state["ticks"] = int(state.get("ticks") or 0) + 1
849:             state["mode"] = "normal"
850:             _write_state(state)
851:             append_event({"event": "tick_idle", "s_n": s_n})
852:             return report
853: 
854:     for task in taken:
855:         task.status = "running"
856:         task.updated_at = _utc()
857:         save_queue(tasks)
858:         append_event({"event": "task_start", "task_id": task.task_id, "kind": task.kind, "s_n": s_n})
859: 
860:         ok, reason = _execute(task, s_n)
861:         task.updated_at = _utc()
862:         task.result = reason
863:         if ok:
864:             task.status = "done"
865:             task.last_error = None
866:         else:
867:             task.retries += 1
868:             task.last_error = reason
869:             denial_reason = str(reason).casefold()
870:             if (
871:                 "law" in denial_reason
872:                 or "security" in denial_reason
873:                 or "tool_gate" in denial_reason
874:                 or "sandbox" in denial_reason
875:             ):
876:                 task.status = "blocked"
877:             elif task.retries > task.max_retries:
878:                 task.status = "failed"
879:             else:
880:                 task.status = "ready"
881:         save_queue(tasks)
882:         append_event(
883:             {
884:                 "event": "task_finish",
885:                 "task_id": task.task_id,
886:                 "kind": task.kind,
887:                 "ok": ok,
888:                 "status": task.status,
889:                 "reason": reason,
890:                 "s_n": s_n,
891:             }
892:         )
893:         report["processed"].append(
894:             {
895:                 "task_id": task.task_id,
896:                 "kind": task.kind,
897:                 "ok": ok,
898:                 "status": task.status,
899:                 "reason": reason,
900:             }
901:         )
902:         state["last_task_id"] = task.task_id
903:         state["last_task_status"] = task.status
904: 
905:     state["heartbeat_at"] = _utc()
906:     state["ticks"] = int(state.get("ticks") or 0) + 1
907:     state["mode"] = "normal"
908:     _write_state(state)
909:     report["s_n"] = s_n
910:     report["exit_code"] = 0 if report["ok"] else 1
911:     return report
912:

924:         "counts": by,

926:         "security": membrane_status(),

250: def _acquire_lock(timeout_s: float = 5.0) -> int:
251:     TRIAD_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
252:     deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout_s
253:     while True:
254:         try:
255:             return os.open(TRIAD_LOCK, os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY)
256:         except FileExistsError:
257:             if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
258:                 raise TriadError("triad_ledger_lock_timeout")
259:             time.sleep(0.025)

262: def _release_lock(fd: int) -> None:
263:     try:
264:         os.close(fd)
265:     finally:
266:         TRIAD_LOCK.unlink(missing_ok=True)

269: def _last_ledger_hash() -> str:
270:     if not TRIAD_LEDGER.is_file():
271:         return "0" * 64
272:     last = ""
273:     with TRIAD_LEDGER.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
274:         for line in handle:
275:             if line.strip():
276:                 last = line
277:     if not last:
278:         return "0" * 64
279:     try:
280:         return str(json.loads(last).get("ledger_hash") or "0" * 64)
281:     except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
282:         raise TriadError("triad_ledger_malformed") from exc

285: def _append_receipt(receipt: TriadReceipt, *, s_n: float) -> TriadReceipt:
286:     security = _security_module()
287:     base = receipt.to_dict()
288:     base.pop("ledger_hash", None)
289:     encoded = _stable_json(base)
290:     gate = security.tool_gate(
291:         "write_file",
292:         {
293:             "path": str(TRIAD_LEDGER).replace("\\", "/"),
294:             "content_sha256": _sha256(encoded.encode("utf-8")),
295:             "bytes": len(encoded.encode("utf-8")),
296:         },
297:         s_n,
298:         forensic_buffer="AIOS Triad receipt append",
299:     )
300:     if not gate.get("allowed"):
301:         raise TriadDenied("triad_ledger_write_denied", evidence=gate)
302:     fd = _acquire_lock()
303:     try:
304:         previous = _last_ledger_hash()
305:         ledger_hash = _sha256({"previous_hash": previous, "receipt": base})
306:         row = {**base, "previous_hash": previous, "ledger_hash": ledger_hash}
307:         TRIAD_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
308:         with TRIAD_LEDGER.open("a", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as handle:
309:             handle.write(_stable_json(row) + "\n")
310:             handle.flush()
311:             os.fsync(handle.fileno())
312:     finally:
313:         _release_lock(fd)
314:     return TriadReceipt(**{**base, "ledger_hash": ledger_hash})

331:         context_id=context.context_id,
332:         stage=stage,
333:         allowed=bool(allowed),
334:         reason=str(reason),
335:         input_sha256=_sha256(input_value),
336:         output_sha256=_sha256(output_value) if output_value is not None else None,
337:         security=dict(security or {}),
338:         pillars=dict(pillars or {}),
339:         created_at=_utc(),
340:     )

359: def open_context(
360:     envelope: TriadEnvelope | Mapping[str, Any],
361:     *,
362:     ttl_s: float = DEFAULT_CONTEXT_TTL_S,
363: ) -> TriadContext:
364:     """Open one fail-closed Security -> RID/AUTO/UML request context."""
365:     env = TriadEnvelope.from_value(envelope)
366:     if not math.isfinite(float(ttl_s)) or not 0.0 < float(ttl_s) <= 3600.0:
367:         raise TriadDenied("invalid_context_ttl")
368:     security = _security_module()
369:     membrane_halt = security.require_membrane()
370:     if membrane_halt:
371:         raise TriadDenied("security_membrane_unavailable", evidence=membrane_halt)
372:     raw = _stable_json(env.to_dict())
373:     ingress = dict(security.ingress_gate(raw, env.s_n))
374:     if not ingress.get("allowed"):
375:         raise TriadDenied("security_ingress_denied", evidence=ingress)
376: 
377:     pillars = _load_pillars()
378:     uml = dict(pillars["uml"].triad_validate_envelope(env.to_dict()))
379:     rid = dict(pillars["rid"].triad_observe(env.to_dict()))
380:     auto = dict(pillars["auto"].triad_decide(env.to_dict(), rid=rid, uml=uml))
381:     versions = {
382:         name: str(module.triad_descriptor().get("version") or "")
383:         for name, module in pillars.items()
384:     }
385:     context = TriadContext(
386:         context_id=uuid.uuid4().hex,
387:         envelope=env,
388:         opened_at=_utc(),
389:         expires_monotonic=time.monotonic() + float(ttl_s),
390:         security_ingress=ingress,
391:         rid=rid,
392:         auto=auto,
393:         uml=uml,
394:         pillar_versions=versions,
395:     )
396:     _ACTIVE_CONTEXTS[context.context_id] = _context_binding(context)
397:     context.validate()
398:     _receipt(
399:         context,
400:         stage="OPEN",
401:         allowed=True,
402:         reason="security_and_triad_allowed",
403:         input_value=env.to_dict(),
404:         security=ingress,
405:         pillars={"rid": rid, "auto": auto, "uml": uml},
406:     )
407:     return context

546: def verify_triad_ledger() -> dict[str, Any]:
547:     previous = "0" * 64
548:     events = 0

550:         return {"ok": True, "events": 0, "head": previous, "path": str(TRIAD_LEDGER)}

552:         for number, line in enumerate(handle, 1):
553:             if not line.strip():
554:                 continue
555:             try:
556:                 row = json.loads(line)
557:             except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
558:                 return {"ok": False, "line": number, "reason": f"malformed:{exc}"}
559:             ledger_hash = str(row.pop("ledger_hash", ""))
560:             row_previous = str(row.pop("previous_hash", ""))
561:             expected = _sha256({"previous_hash": previous, "receipt": row})
562:             if row_previous != previous or ledger_hash != expected:
563:                 return {"ok": False, "line": number, "reason": "hash_chain_mismatch"}
564:             previous = ledger_hash
565:             events += 1
566:     return {
567:         "ok": True,
568:         "events": events,
569:         "head": previous,
570:         "path": str(TRIAD_LEDGER),
571:     }

580:         descriptors = {}
581:         error = f"{type(exc).__name__}:{exc}"
582:     return {
583:         "contract_version": TRIAD_CONTRACT_VERSION,
584:         "pillars": descriptors,
585:         "ledger": verify_triad_ledger(),
586:         "error": error,
587:     }

230: def _load_pillars() -> dict[str, Any]:
231:     modules: dict[str, Any] = {}
232:     for name, module_name in PILLAR_MODULES.items():
233:         module = importlib.import_module(module_name)
234:         descriptor_fn = getattr(module, "triad_descriptor", None)
235:         if descriptor_fn is None:
236:             raise TriadDenied(
237:                 "pillar_contract_missing",
238:                 evidence={"pillar": name, "module": module_name},
239:             )
240:         descriptor = dict(descriptor_fn())
241:         if descriptor.get("triad_contract_version") != TRIAD_CONTRACT_VERSION:
242:             raise TriadDenied(
243:                 "pillar_contract_version_mismatch",
244:                 evidence={"pillar": name, "descriptor": descriptor},
245:             )
246:         modules[name] = module

250: def _acquire_lock(timeout_s: float = 5.0) -> int:
251:     TRIAD_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
252:     deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout_s
253:     while True:
254:         try:
255:             return os.open(TRIAD_LOCK, os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY)
256:         except FileExistsError:
257:             if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
258:                 raise TriadError("triad_ledger_lock_timeout")
259:             time.sleep(0.025)
260: 
261: 
262: def _release_lock(fd: int) -> None:
263:     try:
264:         os.close(fd)
265:     finally:
266:         TRIAD_LOCK.unlink(missing_ok=True)
267: 
268: 
269: def _last_ledger_hash() -> str:
270:     if not TRIAD_LEDGER.is_file():
271:         return "0" * 64
272:     last = ""
273:     with TRIAD_LEDGER.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
274:         for line in handle:
275:             if line.strip():
276:                 last = line
277:     if not last:
278:         return "0" * 64
279:     try:
280:         return str(json.loads(last).get("ledger_hash") or "0" * 64)
281:     except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
282:         raise TriadError("triad_ledger_malformed") from exc

285: def _append_receipt(receipt: TriadReceipt, *, s_n: float) -> TriadReceipt:
286:     security = _security_module()
287:     base = receipt.to_dict()
288:     base.pop("ledger_hash", None)
289:     encoded = _stable_json(base)
290:     gate = security.tool_gate(
291:         "write_file",
292:         {
293:             "path": str(TRIAD_LEDGER).replace("\\", "/"),
294:             "content_sha256": _sha256(encoded.encode("utf-8")),
295:             "bytes": len(encoded.encode("utf-8")),
296:         },
297:         s_n,
298:         forensic_buffer="AIOS Triad receipt append",
299:     )
300:     if not gate.get("allowed"):
301:         raise TriadDenied("triad_ledger_write_denied", evidence=gate)
302:     fd = _acquire_lock()
303:     try:
304:         previous = _last_ledger_hash()
305:         ledger_hash = _sha256({"previous_hash": previous, "receipt": base})
306:         row = {**base, "previous_hash": previous, "ledger_hash": ledger_hash}
307:         TRIAD_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
308:         with TRIAD_LEDGER.open("a", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as handle:
309:             handle.write(_stable_json(row) + "\n")
310:             handle.flush()
311:             os.fsync(handle.fileno())
312:     finally:
313:         _release_lock(fd)
314:     return TriadReceipt(**{**base, "ledger_hash": ledger_hash})

317: def _receipt(
318:     context: TriadContext,
319:     *,

325:     security: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
326:     pillars: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,

328:     receipt = TriadReceipt(
329:         receipt_id=uuid.uuid4().hex,
330:         trace_id=context.envelope.trace_id,
331:         context_id=context.context_id,
332:         stage=stage,
333:         allowed=bool(allowed),
334:         reason=str(reason),
335:         input_sha256=_sha256(input_value),
336:         output_sha256=_sha256(output_value) if output_value is not None else None,
337:         security=dict(security or {}),
338:         pillars=dict(pillars or {}),
339:         created_at=_utc(),
340:     )
341:     return _append_receipt(receipt, s_n=context.envelope.s_n)

359: def open_context(
360:     envelope: TriadEnvelope | Mapping[str, Any],
361:     *,
362:     ttl_s: float = DEFAULT_CONTEXT_TTL_S,
363: ) -> TriadContext:
364:     """Open one fail-closed Security -> RID/AUTO/UML request context."""
365:     env = TriadEnvelope.from_value(envelope)
366:     if not math.isfinite(float(ttl_s)) or not 0.0 < float(ttl_s) <= 3600.0:
367:         raise TriadDenied("invalid_context_ttl")
368:     security = _security_module()
369:     membrane_halt = security.require_membrane()
370:     if membrane_halt:
371:         raise TriadDenied("security_membrane_unavailable", evidence=membrane_halt)
372:     raw = _stable_json(env.to_dict())
373:     ingress = dict(security.ingress_gate(raw, env.s_n))
374:     if not ingress.get("allowed"):
375:         raise TriadDenied("security_ingress_denied", evidence=ingress)
376: 
377:     pillars = _load_pillars()
378:     uml = dict(pillars["uml"].triad_validate_envelope(env.to_dict()))
379:     rid = dict(pillars["rid"].triad_observe(env.to_dict()))
380:     auto = dict(pillars["auto"].triad_decide(env.to_dict(), rid=rid, uml=uml))
381:     versions = {
382:         name: str(module.triad_descriptor().get("version") or "")
383:         for name, module in pillars.items()
384:     }
385:     context = TriadContext(
386:         context_id=uuid.uuid4().hex,
387:         envelope=env,
388:         opened_at=_utc(),
389:         expires_monotonic=time.monotonic() + float(ttl_s),
390:         security_ingress=ingress,
391:         rid=rid,
392:         auto=auto,
393:         uml=uml,
394:         pillar_versions=versions,
395:     )
396:     _ACTIVE_CONTEXTS[context.context_id] = _context_binding(context)
397:     context.validate()
398:     _receipt(
399:         context,
400:         stage="OPEN",
401:         allowed=True,
402:         reason="security_and_triad_allowed",
403:         input_value=env.to_dict(),
404:         security=ingress,
405:         pillars={"rid": rid, "auto": auto, "uml": uml},
406:     )
407:     return context

410: def authorize_operation(
411:     context: TriadContext,
412:     *,
413:     operation: str,
414:     params: Mapping[str, Any],
415:     tool_name: str | None = None,
416: ) -> TriadReceipt:
417:     """Authorize one internal or external operation within an open context."""
418:     context.validate()
419:     pillars = _load_pillars()
420:     structural = dict(
421:         pillars["uml"].triad_validate_operation(
422:             operation=str(operation),
423:             params=dict(params),
424:             context=context.to_dict(),
425:         )
426:     )
427:     policy = dict(
428:         pillars["auto"].triad_authorize_capability(
429:             operation=str(operation),
430:             params=dict(params),
431:             context=context.to_dict(),
432:             uml=structural,
433:         )
434:     )
435:     security_verdict: dict[str, Any] = {"allowed": True, "stage": "internal"}
436:     if tool_name:
437:         security_verdict = dict(
438:             _security_module().tool_gate(
439:                 str(tool_name),
440:                 dict(params),
441:                 context.envelope.s_n,
442:                 forensic_buffer=f"Triad operation {operation}",
443:                 raw_input=_stable_json(context.envelope.to_dict()),
444:             )
445:         )
446:     allowed = bool(structural.get("allowed")) and bool(policy.get("allowed")) and bool(
447:         security_verdict.get("allowed")
448:     )
449:     if allowed:
450:         reason = "authorized"
451:     elif not structural.get("allowed"):
452:         reason = str(structural.get("reason") or "uml_operation_denied")
453:     elif not policy.get("allowed"):
454:         reason = str(policy.get("reason") or "auto_operation_denied")
455:     else:
456:         reason = str(security_verdict.get("reason") or "security_operation_denied")
457:     receipt = _receipt(
458:         context,
459:         stage="DISPATCH",
460:         allowed=allowed,
461:         reason=reason,
462:         input_value={"operation": operation, "params": dict(params)},
463:         security=security_verdict,
464:         pillars={"auto": policy, "uml": structural, "rid": context.rid},
465:     )
466:     if not allowed:
467:         raise TriadDenied(reason, evidence=receipt.to_dict())
468:     return receipt

471: def dispatch(
472:     context: TriadContext,
473:     *,
474:     operation: str,
475:     params: Mapping[str, Any],
476:     handler: Callable[[], Any],
477:     tool_name: str | None = None,
478: ) -> tuple[Any, TriadReceipt]:
479:     """Authorize, execute, and receipt one bounded operation."""
480:     authorize_operation(
481:         context,
482:         operation=operation,
483:         params=params,
484:         tool_name=tool_name,
485:     )
486:     try:
487:         result = handler()
488:     except Exception as exc:
489:         _receipt(
490:             context,
491:             stage="EXECUTE",
492:             allowed=False,
493:             reason=f"{type(exc).__name__}:{exc}",
494:             input_value={"operation": operation, "params": dict(params)},
495:         )
496:         raise
497:     receipt = _receipt(
498:         context,
499:         stage="EXECUTE",
500:         allowed=True,
501:         reason="executed",
502:         input_value={"operation": operation, "params": dict(params)},
503:         output_value=result,
504:     )
505:     return result, receipt
506:

508: def emit(context: TriadContext, result: Any) -> tuple[Any, TriadReceipt]:
509:     """Pass a result back through UML/AUTO/RID and Security OUT."""
510:     context.validate()
511:     pillars = _load_pillars()
512:     structural = dict(
513:         pillars["uml"].triad_validate_result(result=result, context=context.to_dict())
514:     )
515:     policy = dict(
516:         pillars["auto"].triad_authorize_egress(
517:             result=result,
518:             context=context.to_dict(),
519:             uml=structural,
520:         )
521:     )
522:     if not structural.get("allowed") or not policy.get("allowed"):
523:         reason = str(structural.get("reason") or policy.get("reason") or "pillar_egress_denied")
524:         raise TriadDenied(reason, evidence={"uml": structural, "auto": policy})
525:     text = result if isinstance(result, str) else _stable_json(result)
526:     filtered, security_verdict = _security_module().filter_egress(
527:         text, context.envelope.s_n
528:     )
529:     security_result = dict(security_verdict or {"allowed": True, "stage": "empty"})
530:     allowed = bool(security_result.get("allowed", filtered is not None))
531:     receipt = _receipt(
532:         context,
533:         stage="EMIT",
534:         allowed=allowed,
535:         reason="emitted" if allowed else str(security_result.get("reason") or "egress_denied"),
536:         input_value=result,
537:         output_value=filtered,
538:         security=security_result,
539:         pillars={"rid": context.rid, "auto": policy, "uml": structural},
540:     )
541:     if not allowed:
542:         raise TriadDenied("security_egress_denied", evidence=receipt.to_dict())
543:     return filtered, receipt

546: def verify_triad_ledger() -> dict[str, Any]:
547:     previous = "0" * 64
548:     events = 0
549:     if not TRIAD_LEDGER.is_file():
550:         return {"ok": True, "events": 0, "head": previous, "path": str(TRIAD_LEDGER)}
551:     with TRIAD_LEDGER.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
552:         for number, line in enumerate(handle, 1):
553:             if not line.strip():
554:                 continue
555:             try:
556:                 row = json.loads(line)
557:             except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
558:                 return {"ok": False, "line": number, "reason": f"malformed:{exc}"}
559:             ledger_hash = str(row.pop("ledger_hash", ""))
560:             row_previous = str(row.pop("previous_hash", ""))
561:             expected = _sha256({"previous_hash": previous, "receipt": row})
562:             if row_previous != previous or ledger_hash != expected:
563:                 return {"ok": False, "line": number, "reason": "hash_chain_mismatch"}
564:             previous = ledger_hash
565:             events += 1
566:     return {
567:         "ok": True,
568:         "events": events,
569:         "head": previous,
570:         "path": str(TRIAD_LEDGER),
571:     }
572: 
573: 
574: def triad_status() -> dict[str, Any]:
575:     try:
576:         pillars = _load_pillars()
577:         descriptors = {name: module.triad_descriptor() for name, module in pillars.items()}
578:         error = None
579:     except Exception as exc:  # status reports; operations still fail closed
580:         descriptors = {}
581:         error = f"{type(exc).__name__}:{exc}"
582:     return {
583:         "contract_version": TRIAD_CONTRACT_VERSION,
584:         "pillars": descriptors,
585:         "ledger": verify_triad_ledger(),
586:         "error": error,
587:     }

204:     verdict = egress_gate(str(text), s_n, cpu_card=cpu_card)
205:     if verdict.get("allowed"):
206:         return str(text), verdict
207:     log_event("egress_blocked", verdict, text=str(text)[:500])
208:     return BLOCKED_EGRESS, verdict
209: 
210: 
211: def log_event(kind: str, verdict: dict[str, Any], **extra: Any) -> None:
212:     row = {
213:         "schema_version": "viv_security_membrane_event_v1",
214:         "run_id": f"security_{uuid.uuid4().hex}",
215:         "timestamp": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
216:         "kind": kind,
217:         "verdict": verdict,
218:         **extra,
219:     }
220:     try:
221:         # Security denials must be persisted without re-entering tool_gate.
222:         # The membrane has already evaluated the originating action; the
223:         # private sink only appends a hash-chained evidence row.
224:         from lib.cpu_execution_envelope import AppendOnlyExecutionLedger
225: 
226:         AppendOnlyExecutionLedger(EVENTS_PATH).append(row, _security_probe=False)
227:     except Exception:
228:         # Keep the membrane non-throwing if the audit sink itself is damaged.
229:         # This is a degraded evidence condition, never an authorization grant;
230:         # the caller still receives the original deny verdict.
231:         return
232: 
233: 
234: def heartbeat_stamp(s_n: float) -> dict[str, Any]:
235:     st = membrane_status()
236:     st["s_n"] = s_n
237:     st["ingress"] = "armed" if st["armed"] else "missing"
238:     st["egress"] = "armed" if st["armed"] else "missing"
239:     return st

103:         if scope == "runtime_health":
