471: def dispatch(
472:     context: TriadContext,
473:     *,
474:     operation: str,
475:     params: Mapping[str, Any],
476:     handler: Callable[[], Any],
477:     tool_name: str | None = None,
478: ) -> tuple[Any, TriadReceipt]:
479:     """Authorize, execute, and receipt one bounded operation."""
480:     authorize_operation(
481:         context,
482:         operation=operation,
483:         params=params,
484:         tool_name=tool_name,
485:     )
486:     try:
487:         result = handler()
488:     except Exception as exc:
489:         _receipt(
490:             context,
491:             stage="EXECUTE",
492:             allowed=False,
493:             reason=f"{type(exc).__name__}:{exc}",
494:             input_value={"operation": operation, "params": dict(params)},
495:         )
496:         raise
497:     receipt = _receipt(
498:         context,
499:         stage="EXECUTE",
500:         allowed=True,
501:         reason="executed",
502:         input_value={"operation": operation, "params": dict(params)},
503:         output_value=result,
504:     )
505:     return result, receipt
506: 
507: 
508: def emit(context: TriadContext, result: Any) -> tuple[Any, TriadReceipt]:
509:     """Pass a result back through UML/AUTO/RID and Security OUT."""
510:     context.validate()
511:     pillars = _load_pillars()
512:     structural = dict(
513:         pillars["uml"].triad_validate_result(result=result, context=context.to_dict())
514:     )
515:     policy = dict(
516:         pillars["auto"].triad_authorize_egress(
517:             result=result,
518:             context=context.to_dict(),
519:             uml=structural,
520:         )
521:     )
522:     if not structural.get("allowed") or not policy.get("allowed"):
523:         reason = str(structural.get("reason") or policy.get("reason") or "pillar_egress_denied")
524:         raise TriadDenied(reason, evidence={"uml": structural, "auto": policy})
525:     text = result if isinstance(result, str) else _stable_json(result)
526:     filtered, security_verdict = _security_module().filter_egress(
527:         text, context.envelope.s_n
528:     )
529:     security_result = dict(security_verdict or {"allowed": True, "stage": "empty"})
530:     allowed = bool(security_result.get("allowed", filtered is not None))
531:     receipt = _receipt(
532:         context,
533:         stage="EMIT",
534:         allowed=allowed,
535:         reason="emitted" if allowed else str(security_result.get("reason") or "egress_denied"),
536:         input_value=result,
537:         output_value=filtered,
538:         security=security_result,
539:         pillars={"rid": context.rid, "auto": policy, "uml": structural},
540:     )
541:     if not allowed:
542:         raise TriadDenied("security_egress_denied", evidence=receipt.to_dict())
543:     return filtered, receipt
544:

546: def verify_triad_ledger() -> dict[str, Any]:
547:     previous = "0" * 64
548:     events = 0
549:     if not TRIAD_LEDGER.is_file():
550:         return {"ok": True, "events": 0, "head": previous, "path": str(TRIAD_LEDGER)}
551:     with TRIAD_LEDGER.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
552:         for number, line in enumerate(handle, 1):
553:             if not line.strip():
554:                 continue
555:             try:
556:                 row = json.loads(line)
557:             except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
558:                 return {"ok": False, "line": number, "reason": f"malformed:{exc}"}
559:             ledger_hash = str(row.pop("ledger_hash", ""))
560:             row_previous = str(row.pop("previous_hash", ""))
561:             expected = _sha256({"previous_hash": previous, "receipt": row})
562:             if row_previous != previous or ledger_hash != expected:
563:                 return {"ok": False, "line": number, "reason": "hash_chain_mismatch"}
564:             previous = ledger_hash
565:             events += 1
566:     return {
567:         "ok": True,
568:         "events": events,
569:         "head": previous,
570:         "path": str(TRIAD_LEDGER),
571:     }
572: 
573: 
574: def triad_status() -> dict[str, Any]:
575:     try:
576:         pillars = _load_pillars()
577:         descriptors = {name: module.triad_descriptor() for name, module in pillars.items()}
578:         error = None
579:     except Exception as exc:  # status reports; operations still fail closed
580:         descriptors = {}
581:         error = f"{type(exc).__name__}:{exc}"
582:     return {
583:         "contract_version": TRIAD_CONTRACT_VERSION,
584:         "pillars": descriptors,
585:         "ledger": verify_triad_ledger(),
586:         "error": error,
587:     }

285: def _append_receipt(receipt: TriadReceipt, *, s_n: float) -> TriadReceipt:

519:             uml=structural,

521:     )
522:     if not structural.get("allowed") or not policy.get("allowed"):
523:         reason = str(structural.get("reason") or policy.get("reason") or "pillar_egress_denied")
524:         raise TriadDenied(reason, evidence={"uml": structural, "auto": policy})
525:     text = result if isinstance(result, str) else _stable_json(result)
526:     filtered, security_verdict = _security_module().filter_egress(
527:         text, context.envelope.s_n
528:     )
529:     security_result = dict(security_verdict or {"allowed": True, "stage": "empty"})
530:     allowed = bool(security_result.get("allowed", filtered is not None))
531:     receipt = _receipt(
532:         context,
533:         stage="EMIT",
534:         allowed=allowed,
535:         reason="emitted" if allowed else str(security_result.get("reason") or "egress_denied"),
536:         input_value=result,
537:         output_value=filtered,
538:         security=security_result,
539:         pillars={"rid": context.rid, "auto": policy, "uml": structural},
540:     )
541:     if not allowed:
542:         raise TriadDenied("security_egress_denied", evidence=receipt.to_dict())
543:     return filtered, receipt

546: def verify_triad_ledger() -> dict[str, Any]:
547:     previous = "0" * 64
548:     events = 0
549:     if not TRIAD_LEDGER.is_file():
550:         return {"ok": True, "events": 0, "head": previous, "path": str(TRIAD_LEDGER)}
551:     with TRIAD_LEDGER.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
552:         for number, line in enumerate(handle, 1):
553:             if not line.strip():
554:                 continue
555:             try:
556:                 row = json.loads(line)
557:             except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
558:                 return {"ok": False, "line": number, "reason": f"malformed:{exc}"}
559:             ledger_hash = str(row.pop("ledger_hash", ""))
560:             row_previous = str(row.pop("previous_hash", ""))
561:             expected = _sha256({"previous_hash": previous, "receipt": row})
562:             if row_previous != previous or ledger_hash != expected:
563:                 return {"ok": False, "line": number, "reason": "hash_chain_mismatch"}
564:             previous = ledger_hash
565:             events += 1
566:     return {
567:         "ok": True,
568:         "events": events,
569:         "head": previous,
570:         "path": str(TRIAD_LEDGER),
571:     }

250: def _acquire_lock(timeout_s: float = 5.0) -> int:
251:     TRIAD_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
252:     deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout_s
253:     while True:
254:         try:
255:             return os.open(TRIAD_LOCK, os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY)
256:         except FileExistsError:
257:             if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
258:                 raise TriadError("triad_ledger_lock_timeout")
259:             time.sleep(0.025)

262: def _release_lock(fd: int) -> None:
263:     try:
264:         os.close(fd)
265:     finally:
266:         TRIAD_LOCK.unlink(missing_ok=True)

269: def _last_ledger_hash() -> str:
270:     if not TRIAD_LEDGER.is_file():
271:         return "0" * 64
272:     last = ""
273:     with TRIAD_LEDGER.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
274:         for line in handle:
275:             if line.strip():
276:                 last = line
277:     if not last:
278:         return "0" * 64
279:     try:
280:         return str(json.loads(last).get("ledger_hash") or "0" * 64)
281:     except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
282:         raise TriadError("triad_ledger_malformed") from exc

285: def _append_receipt(receipt: TriadReceipt, *, s_n: float) -> TriadReceipt:
286:     security = _security_module()
287:     base = receipt.to_dict()
288:     base.pop("ledger_hash", None)
289:     encoded = _stable_json(base)
290:     gate = security.tool_gate(
291:         "write_file",
292:         {
293:             "path": str(TRIAD_LEDGER).replace("\\", "/"),
294:             "content_sha256": _sha256(encoded.encode("utf-8")),
295:             "bytes": len(encoded.encode("utf-8")),
296:         },
297:         s_n,
298:         forensic_buffer="AIOS Triad receipt append",
299:     )
300:     if not gate.get("allowed"):
301:         raise TriadDenied("triad_ledger_write_denied", evidence=gate)
302:     fd = _acquire_lock()
303:     try:
304:         previous = _last_ledger_hash()
305:         ledger_hash = _sha256({"previous_hash": previous, "receipt": base})
306:         row = {**base, "previous_hash": previous, "ledger_hash": ledger_hash}
307:         TRIAD_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
308:         with TRIAD_LEDGER.open("a", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as handle:
309:             handle.write(_stable_json(row) + "\n")
310:             handle.flush()
311:             os.fsync(handle.fileno())
312:     finally:
313:         _release_lock(fd)
314:     return TriadReceipt(**{**base, "ledger_hash": ledger_hash})

359: def open_context(

363: ) -> TriadContext:

366:     if not math.isfinite(float(ttl_s)) or not 0.0 < float(ttl_s) <= 3600.0:
367:         raise TriadDenied("invalid_context_ttl")

369:     membrane_halt = security.require_membrane()

371:         raise TriadDenied("security_membrane_unavailable", evidence=membrane_halt)

377:     pillars = _load_pillars()

380:     auto = dict(pillars["auto"].triad_decide(env.to_dict(), rid=rid, uml=uml))
381:     versions = {
382:         name: str(module.triad_descriptor().get("version") or "")
383:         for name, module in pillars.items()

385:     context = TriadContext(
386:         context_id=uuid.uuid4().hex,
387:         envelope=env,
388:         opened_at=_utc(),
389:         expires_monotonic=time.monotonic() + float(ttl_s),
390:         security_ingress=ingress,
391:         rid=rid,
392:         auto=auto,
393:         uml=uml,
394:         pillar_versions=versions,

399:         context,
400:         stage="OPEN",
401:         allowed=True,
402:         reason="security_and_triad_allowed",
403:         input_value=env.to_dict(),
404:         security=ingress,
405:         pillars={"rid": rid, "auto": auto, "uml": uml},
406:     )

410: def authorize_operation(

471: def dispatch(
472:     context: TriadContext,
473:     *,
474:     operation: str,
475:     params: Mapping[str, Any],

494:             input_value={"operation": operation, "params": dict(params)},

496:         raise

498:         context,
499:         stage="EXECUTE",
500:         allowed=True,
501:         reason="executed",
502:         input_value={"operation": operation, "params": dict(params)},
503:         output_value=result,
504:     )
505:     return result, receipt

508: def emit(context: TriadContext, result: Any) -> tuple[Any, TriadReceipt]:
509:     """Pass a result back through UML/AUTO/RID and Security OUT."""
510:     context.validate()

513:         pillars["uml"].triad_validate_result(result=result, context=context.to_dict())

515:     policy = dict(

518:             context=context.to_dict(),
519:             uml=structural,

521:     )
522:     if not structural.get("allowed") or not policy.get("allowed"):
523:         reason = str(structural.get("reason") or policy.get("reason") or "pillar_egress_denied")
524:         raise TriadDenied(reason, evidence={"uml": structural, "auto": policy})

527:         text, context.envelope.s_n

529:     security_result = dict(security_verdict or {"allowed": True, "stage": "empty"})
530:     allowed = bool(security_result.get("allowed", filtered is not None))
531:     receipt = _receipt(
532:         context,
533:         stage="EMIT",
534:         allowed=allowed,
535:         reason="emitted" if allowed else str(security_result.get("reason") or "egress_denied"),
536:         input_value=result,
537:         output_value=filtered,
538:         security=security_result,
539:         pillars={"rid": context.rid, "auto": policy, "uml": structural},
540:     )
541:     if not allowed:
542:         raise TriadDenied("security_egress_denied", evidence=receipt.to_dict())

546: def verify_triad_ledger() -> dict[str, Any]:
547:     previous = "0" * 64

549:     if not TRIAD_LEDGER.is_file():
550:         return {"ok": True, "events": 0, "head": previous, "path": str(TRIAD_LEDGER)}
551:     with TRIAD_LEDGER.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
552:         for number, line in enumerate(handle, 1):
553:             if not line.strip():
554:                 continue
555:             try:

560:             row_previous = str(row.pop("previous_hash", ""))
561:             expected = _sha256({"previous_hash": previous, "receipt": row})
562:             if row_previous != previous or ledger_hash != expected:
563:                 return {"ok": False, "line": number, "reason": "hash_chain_mismatch"}
564:             previous = ledger_hash
565:             events += 1
566:     return {
567:         "ok": True,
568:         "events": events,
569:         "head": previous,
570:         "path": str(TRIAD_LEDGER),
571:     }

233:         module = importlib.import_module(module_name)
234:         descriptor_fn = getattr(module, "triad_descriptor", None)
235:         if descriptor_fn is None:
236:             raise TriadDenied(
237:                 "pillar_contract_missing",
238:                 evidence={"pillar": name, "module": module_name},
239:             )
240:         descriptor = dict(descriptor_fn())
241:         if descriptor.get("triad_contract_version") != TRIAD_CONTRACT_VERSION:
242:             raise TriadDenied(
243:                 "pillar_contract_version_mismatch",
244:                 evidence={"pillar": name, "descriptor": descriptor},
245:             )
246:         modules[name] = module
247:     return modules
248: 
249: 
250: def _acquire_lock(timeout_s: float = 5.0) -> int:
251:     TRIAD_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
252:     deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout_s
253:     while True:
254:         try:
255:             return os.open(TRIAD_LOCK, os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY)
256:         except FileExistsError:
257:             if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
258:                 raise TriadError("triad_ledger_lock_timeout")
259:             time.sleep(0.025)
260: 
261: 
262: def _release_lock(fd: int) -> None:
263:     try:
264:         os.close(fd)
265:     finally:
266:         TRIAD_LOCK.unlink(missing_ok=True)
267: 
268: 
269: def _last_ledger_hash() -> str:
270:     if not TRIAD_LEDGER.is_file():
271:         return "0" * 64
272:     last = ""
273:     with TRIAD_LEDGER.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
274:         for line in handle:
275:             if line.strip():
276:                 last = line
277:     if not last:
278:         return "0" * 64
279:     try:
280:         return str(json.loads(last).get("ledger_hash") or "0" * 64)
281:     except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
282:         raise TriadError("triad_ledger_malformed") from exc
283: 
284: 
285: def _append_receipt(receipt: TriadReceipt, *, s_n: float) -> TriadReceipt:
286:     security = _security_module()
287:     base = receipt.to_dict()
288:     base.pop("ledger_hash", None)
289:     encoded = _stable_json(base)
290:     gate = security.tool_gate(
291:         "write_file",
292:         {
293:             "path": str(TRIAD_LEDGER).replace("\\", "/"),
294:             "content_sha256": _sha256(encoded.encode("utf-8")),
295:             "bytes": len(encoded.encode("utf-8")),
296:         },
297:         s_n,
298:         forensic_buffer="AIOS Triad receipt append",
299:     )
300:     if not gate.get("allowed"):
301:         raise TriadDenied("triad_ledger_write_denied", evidence=gate)
302:     fd = _acquire_lock()
303:     try:
304:         previous = _last_ledger_hash()
305:         ledger_hash = _sha256({"previous_hash": previous, "receipt": base})
306:         row = {**base, "previous_hash": previous, "ledger_hash": ledger_hash}
307:         TRIAD_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
308:         with TRIAD_LEDGER.open("a", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as handle:
309:             handle.write(_stable_json(row) + "\n")
310:             handle.flush()
311:             os.fsync(handle.fileno())
312:     finally:
313:         _release_lock(fd)
314:     return TriadReceipt(**{**base, "ledger_hash": ledger_hash})
315: 
316: 
317: def _receipt(
318:     context: TriadContext,
319:     *,
320:     stage: str,
321:     allowed: bool,
322:     reason: str,
323:     input_value: Any,
324:     output_value: Any = None,
325:     security: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
326:     pillars: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
327: ) -> TriadReceipt:
328:     receipt = TriadReceipt(
329:         receipt_id=uuid.uuid4().hex,
330:         trace_id=context.envelope.trace_id,
331:         context_id=context.context_id,
332:         stage=stage,
333:         allowed=bool(allowed),
334:         reason=str(reason),
335:         input_sha256=_sha256(input_value),
336:         output_sha256=_sha256(output_value) if output_value is not None else None,
337:         security=dict(security or {}),
338:         pillars=dict(pillars or {}),
339:         created_at=_utc(),
340:     )
341:     return _append_receipt(receipt, s_n=context.envelope.s_n)
342: 
343: 
344: def _context_binding(context: TriadContext) -> str:
345:     return _sha256(
346:         {
347:             "context_id": context.context_id,
348:             "envelope": context.envelope.to_dict(),
349:             "opened_at": context.opened_at,
350:             "security_ingress": context.security_ingress,
351:             "rid": context.rid,
352:             "auto": context.auto,
353:             "uml": context.uml,
354:             "pillar_versions": context.pillar_versions,
355:         }
356:     )
357: 
358: 
359: def open_context(
360:     envelope: TriadEnvelope | Mapping[str, Any],
361:     *,
362:     ttl_s: float = DEFAULT_CONTEXT_TTL_S,
363: ) -> TriadContext:
364:     """Open one fail-closed Security -> RID/AUTO/UML request context."""
365:     env = TriadEnvelope.from_value(envelope)
366:     if not math.isfinite(float(ttl_s)) or not 0.0 < float(ttl_s) <= 3600.0:
367:         raise TriadDenied("invalid_context_ttl")
368:     security = _security_module()
369:     membrane_halt = security.require_membrane()
370:     if membrane_halt:
371:         raise TriadDenied("security_membrane_unavailable", evidence=membrane_halt)
372:     raw = _stable_json(env.to_dict())
373:     ingress = dict(security.ingress_gate(raw, env.s_n))
374:     if not ingress.get("allowed"):
375:         raise TriadDenied("security_ingress_denied", evidence=ingress)
376: 
377:     pillars = _load_pillars()
378:     uml = dict(pillars["uml"].triad_validate_envelope(env.to_dict()))
379:     rid = dict(pillars["rid"].triad_observe(env.to_dict()))
380:     auto = dict(pillars["auto"].triad_decide(env.to_dict(), rid=rid, uml=uml))
381:     versions = {
382:         name: str(module.triad_descriptor().get("version") or "")
383:         for name, module in pillars.items()
384:     }
385:     context = TriadContext(
386:         context_id=uuid.uuid4().hex,
387:         envelope=env,
388:         opened_at=_utc(),
389:         expires_monotonic=time.monotonic() + float(ttl_s),
390:         security_ingress=ingress,
391:         rid=rid,
392:         auto=auto,
393:         uml=uml,
394:         pillar_versions=versions,
395:     )
396:     _ACTIVE_CONTEXTS[context.context_id] = _context_binding(context)
397:     context.validate()
398:     _receipt(
399:         context,
400:         stage="OPEN",
401:         allowed=True,
402:         reason="security_and_triad_allowed",
403:         input_value=env.to_dict(),
404:         security=ingress,
405:         pillars={"rid": rid, "auto": auto, "uml": uml},
406:     )
407:     return context
408: 
409: 
410: def authorize_operation(
411:     context: TriadContext,
412:     *,
413:     operation: str,
414:     params: Mapping[str, Any],
415:     tool_name: str | None = None,
416: ) -> TriadReceipt:
417:     """Authorize one internal or external operation within an open context."""
418:     context.validate()
419:     pillars = _load_pillars()
420:     structural = dict(
421:         pillars["uml"].triad_validate_operation(
422:             operation=str(operation),
423:             params=dict(params),
424:             context=context.to_dict(),
425:         )
426:     )
427:     policy = dict(
428:         pillars["auto"].triad_authorize_capability(
429:             operation=str(operation),
430:             params=dict(params),
431:             context=context.to_dict(),
432:             uml=structural,
433:         )
434:     )
435:     security_verdict: dict[str, Any] = {"allowed": True, "stage": "internal"}
436:     if tool_name:
437:         security_verdict = dict(
438:             _security_module().tool_gate(
439:                 str(tool_name),
440:                 dict(params),
441:                 context.envelope.s_n,
442:                 forensic_buffer=f"Triad operation {operation}",
443:                 raw_input=_stable_json(context.envelope.to_dict()),
444:             )
445:         )
446:     allowed = bool(structural.get("allowed")) and bool(policy.get("allowed")) and bool(
447:         security_verdict.get("allowed")
448:     )
449:     if allowed:
450:         reason = "authorized"
451:     elif not structural.get("allowed"):
452:         reason = str(structural.get("reason") or "uml_operation_denied")
453:     elif not policy.get("allowed"):
454:         reason = str(policy.get("reason") or "auto_operation_denied")
455:     else:
456:         reason = str(security_verdict.get("reason") or "security_operation_denied")
457:     receipt = _receipt(
458:         context,
459:         stage="DISPATCH",
460:         allowed=allowed,
461:         reason=reason,
462:         input_value={"operation": operation, "params": dict(params)},
463:         security=security_verdict,
464:         pillars={"auto": policy, "uml": structural, "rid": context.rid},
465:     )
466:     if not allowed:
467:         raise TriadDenied(reason, evidence=receipt.to_dict())
468:     return receipt
469: 
470: 
471: def dispatch(
472:     context: TriadContext,
473:     *,
474:     operation: str,
475:     params: Mapping[str, Any],
476:     handler: Callable[[], Any],
477:     tool_name: str | None = None,
478: ) -> tuple[Any, TriadReceipt]:
479:     """Authorize, execute, and receipt one bounded operation."""
480:     authorize_operation(
481:         context,
482:         operation=operation,
483:         params=params,
484:         tool_name=tool_name,
485:     )
486:     try:
487:         result = handler()
488:     except Exception as exc:
489:         _receipt(
490:             context,
491:             stage="EXECUTE",
492:             allowed=False,
493:             reason=f"{type(exc).__name__}:{exc}",
494:             input_value={"operation": operation, "params": dict(params)},
495:         )
496:         raise
497:     receipt = _receipt(
498:         context,
499:         stage="EXECUTE",
500:         allowed=True,
501:         reason="executed",
502:         input_value={"operation": operation, "params": dict(params)},
503:         output_value=result,
504:     )
505:     return result, receipt
506: 
507: 
508: def emit(context: TriadContext, result: Any) -> tuple[Any, TriadReceipt]:
509:     """Pass a result back through UML/AUTO/RID and Security OUT."""
510:     context.validate()
511:     pillars = _load_pillars()
512:     structural = dict(
513:         pillars["uml"].triad_validate_result(result=result, context=context.to_dict())
514:     )
515:     policy = dict(
516:         pillars["auto"].triad_authorize_egress(
517:             result=result,
518:             context=context.to_dict(),
519:             uml=structural,
520:         )
521:     )
522:     if not structural.get("allowed") or not policy.get("allowed"):
523:         reason = str(structural.get("reason") or policy.get("reason") or "pillar_egress_denied")
524:         raise TriadDenied(reason, evidence={"uml": structural, "auto": policy})
525:     text = result if isinstance(result, str) else _stable_json(result)
526:     filtered, security_verdict = _security_module().filter_egress(
527:         text, context.envelope.s_n
528:     )
529:     security_result = dict(security_verdict or {"allowed": True, "stage": "empty"})
530:     allowed = bool(security_result.get("allowed", filtered is not None))
531:     receipt = _receipt(
532:         context,
533:         stage="EMIT",
534:         allowed=allowed,
535:         reason="emitted" if allowed else str(security_result.get("reason") or "egress_denied"),
536:         input_value=result,
537:         output_value=filtered,
538:         security=security_result,
539:         pillars={"rid": context.rid, "auto": policy, "uml": structural},
540:     )
541:     if not allowed:
542:         raise TriadDenied("security_egress_denied", evidence=receipt.to_dict())
543:     return filtered, receipt
544:

546: def verify_triad_ledger() -> dict[str, Any]:
547:     previous = "0" * 64
548:     events = 0
549:     if not TRIAD_LEDGER.is_file():
550:         return {"ok": True, "events": 0, "head": previous, "path": str(TRIAD_LEDGER)}
551:     with TRIAD_LEDGER.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
552:         for number, line in enumerate(handle, 1):
553:             if not line.strip():
554:                 continue
555:             try:
556:                 row = json.loads(line)
557:             except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
558:                 return {"ok": False, "line": number, "reason": f"malformed:{exc}"}
559:             ledger_hash = str(row.pop("ledger_hash", ""))
560:             row_previous = str(row.pop("previous_hash", ""))
561:             expected = _sha256({"previous_hash": previous, "receipt": row})
562:             if row_previous != previous or ledger_hash != expected:
563:                 return {"ok": False, "line": number, "reason": "hash_chain_mismatch"}
564:             previous = ledger_hash
565:             events += 1
566:     return {
567:         "ok": True,
568:         "events": events,
569:         "head": previous,
570:         "path": str(TRIAD_LEDGER),
571:     }
572: 
573: 
574: def triad_status() -> dict[str, Any]:
575:     try:
576:         pillars = _load_pillars()
577:         descriptors = {name: module.triad_descriptor() for name, module in pillars.items()}
578:         error = None
579:     except Exception as exc:  # status reports; operations still fail closed
580:         descriptors = {}
581:         error = f"{type(exc).__name__}:{exc}"
582:     return {
583:         "contract_version": TRIAD_CONTRACT_VERSION,
584:         "pillars": descriptors,
585:         "ledger": verify_triad_ledger(),
586:         "error": error,
587:     }

250: def _acquire_lock(timeout_s: float = 5.0) -> int:
251:     TRIAD_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
252:     deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout_s
253:     while True:
254:         try:
255:             return os.open(TRIAD_LOCK, os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY)
256:         except FileExistsError:

259:             time.sleep(0.025)

265:     finally:

272:     last = ""
273:     with TRIAD_LEDGER.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
274:         for line in handle:
275:             if line.strip():
276:                 last = line
277:     if not last:
278:         return "0" * 64
279:     try:
280:         return str(json.loads(last).get("ledger_hash") or "0" * 64)
281:     except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:

285: def _append_receipt(receipt: TriadReceipt, *, s_n: float) -> TriadReceipt:
286:     security = _security_module()
287:     base = receipt.to_dict()
288:     base.pop("ledger_hash", None)
289:     encoded = _stable_json(base)
290:     gate = security.tool_gate(
291:         "write_file",
292:         {
293:             "path": str(TRIAD_LEDGER).replace("\\", "/"),
294:             "content_sha256": _sha256(encoded.encode("utf-8")),
295:             "bytes": len(encoded.encode("utf-8")),
296:         },
297:         s_n,
298:         forensic_buffer="AIOS Triad receipt append",
299:     )
300:     if not gate.get("allowed"):
301:         raise TriadDenied("triad_ledger_write_denied", evidence=gate)
302:     fd = _acquire_lock()
303:     try:
304:         previous = _last_ledger_hash()
305:         ledger_hash = _sha256({"previous_hash": previous, "receipt": base})
306:         row = {**base, "previous_hash": previous, "ledger_hash": ledger_hash}
307:         TRIAD_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
308:         with TRIAD_LEDGER.open("a", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as handle:
309:             handle.write(_stable_json(row) + "\n")
310:             handle.flush()
311:             os.fsync(handle.fileno())
312:     finally:
313:         _release_lock(fd)
314:     return TriadReceipt(**{**base, "ledger_hash": ledger_hash})

337:         security=dict(security or {}),

359: def open_context(
360:     envelope: TriadEnvelope | Mapping[str, Any],
361:     *,
362:     ttl_s: float = DEFAULT_CONTEXT_TTL_S,
363: ) -> TriadContext:
364:     """Open one fail-closed Security -> RID/AUTO/UML request context."""
365:     env = TriadEnvelope.from_value(envelope)
366:     if not math.isfinite(float(ttl_s)) or not 0.0 < float(ttl_s) <= 3600.0:
367:         raise TriadDenied("invalid_context_ttl")
368:     security = _security_module()
369:     membrane_halt = security.require_membrane()
370:     if membrane_halt:
371:         raise TriadDenied("security_membrane_unavailable", evidence=membrane_halt)
372:     raw = _stable_json(env.to_dict())
373:     ingress = dict(security.ingress_gate(raw, env.s_n))
374:     if not ingress.get("allowed"):
375:         raise TriadDenied("security_ingress_denied", evidence=ingress)
376: 
377:     pillars = _load_pillars()
378:     uml = dict(pillars["uml"].triad_validate_envelope(env.to_dict()))
379:     rid = dict(pillars["rid"].triad_observe(env.to_dict()))
380:     auto = dict(pillars["auto"].triad_decide(env.to_dict(), rid=rid, uml=uml))
381:     versions = {
382:         name: str(module.triad_descriptor().get("version") or "")
383:         for name, module in pillars.items()
384:     }
385:     context = TriadContext(
386:         context_id=uuid.uuid4().hex,
387:         envelope=env,
388:         opened_at=_utc(),
389:         expires_monotonic=time.monotonic() + float(ttl_s),
390:         security_ingress=ingress,
391:         rid=rid,
392:         auto=auto,
393:         uml=uml,
394:         pillar_versions=versions,
395:     )
396:     _ACTIVE_CONTEXTS[context.context_id] = _context_binding(context)
397:     context.validate()
398:     _receipt(
399:         context,
400:         stage="OPEN",
401:         allowed=True,
402:         reason="security_and_triad_allowed",
403:         input_value=env.to_dict(),
404:         security=ingress,
405:         pillars={"rid": rid, "auto": auto, "uml": uml},
406:     )
407:     return context

471: def dispatch(
472:     context: TriadContext,
473:     *,
474:     operation: str,
475:     params: Mapping[str, Any],
476:     handler: Callable[[], Any],
477:     tool_name: str | None = None,
478: ) -> tuple[Any, TriadReceipt]:
479:     """Authorize, execute, and receipt one bounded operation."""
480:     authorize_operation(
481:         context,
482:         operation=operation,
483:         params=params,
484:         tool_name=tool_name,
485:     )
486:     try:
487:         result = handler()
488:     except Exception as exc:
489:         _receipt(
490:             context,
491:             stage="EXECUTE",
492:             allowed=False,
493:             reason=f"{type(exc).__name__}:{exc}",
494:             input_value={"operation": operation, "params": dict(params)},
495:         )
496:         raise
497:     receipt = _receipt(
498:         context,
499:         stage="EXECUTE",
500:         allowed=True,
501:         reason="executed",
502:         input_value={"operation": operation, "params": dict(params)},
503:         output_value=result,
504:     )
505:     return result, receipt
506: 
507: 
508: def emit(context: TriadContext, result: Any) -> tuple[Any, TriadReceipt]:
509:     """Pass a result back through UML/AUTO/RID and Security OUT."""
510:     context.validate()
511:     pillars = _load_pillars()
512:     structural = dict(
513:         pillars["uml"].triad_validate_result(result=result, context=context.to_dict())
514:     )
515:     policy = dict(
516:         pillars["auto"].triad_authorize_egress(
517:             result=result,
518:             context=context.to_dict(),
519:             uml=structural,
520:         )
521:     )
522:     if not structural.get("allowed") or not policy.get("allowed"):
523:         reason = str(structural.get("reason") or policy.get("reason") or "pillar_egress_denied")
524:         raise TriadDenied(reason, evidence={"uml": structural, "auto": policy})
525:     text = result if isinstance(result, str) else _stable_json(result)
526:     filtered, security_verdict = _security_module().filter_egress(
527:         text, context.envelope.s_n
528:     )
529:     security_result = dict(security_verdict or {"allowed": True, "stage": "empty"})
530:     allowed = bool(security_result.get("allowed", filtered is not None))
531:     receipt = _receipt(
532:         context,
533:         stage="EMIT",
534:         allowed=allowed,
535:         reason="emitted" if allowed else str(security_result.get("reason") or "egress_denied"),
536:         input_value=result,
537:         output_value=filtered,
538:         security=security_result,
539:         pillars={"rid": context.rid, "auto": policy, "uml": structural},
540:     )
541:     if not allowed:
542:         raise TriadDenied("security_egress_denied", evidence=receipt.to_dict())
543:     return filtered, receipt

546: def verify_triad_ledger() -> dict[str, Any]:
547:     previous = "0" * 64
548:     events = 0
549:     if not TRIAD_LEDGER.is_file():
550:         return {"ok": True, "events": 0, "head": previous, "path": str(TRIAD_LEDGER)}
551:     with TRIAD_LEDGER.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
552:         for number, line in enumerate(handle, 1):
553:             if not line.strip():
554:                 continue
555:             try:
556:                 row = json.loads(line)
557:             except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
558:                 return {"ok": False, "line": number, "reason": f"malformed:{exc}"}
559:             ledger_hash = str(row.pop("ledger_hash", ""))
560:             row_previous = str(row.pop("previous_hash", ""))
561:             expected = _sha256({"previous_hash": previous, "receipt": row})
562:             if row_previous != previous or ledger_hash != expected:
563:                 return {"ok": False, "line": number, "reason": "hash_chain_mismatch"}
564:             previous = ledger_hash
565:             events += 1
566:     return {
567:         "ok": True,
568:         "events": events,
569:         "head": previous,
570:         "path": str(TRIAD_LEDGER),
571:     }
572: 
573: 
574: def triad_status() -> dict[str, Any]:
575:     try:
576:         pillars = _load_pillars()
577:         descriptors = {name: module.triad_descriptor() for name, module in pillars.items()}
578:         error = None
579:     except Exception as exc:  # status reports; operations still fail closed
580:         descriptors = {}
581:         error = f"{type(exc).__name__}:{exc}"
582:     return {
583:         "contract_version": TRIAD_CONTRACT_VERSION,
584:         "pillars": descriptors,
585:         "ledger": verify_triad_ledger(),
586:         "error": error,
587:     }

546: def verify_triad_ledger() -> dict[str, Any]:
547:     previous = "0" * 64
548:     events = 0
549:     if not TRIAD_LEDGER.is_file():
550:         return {"ok": True, "events": 0, "head": previous, "path": str(TRIAD_LEDGER)}
551:     with TRIAD_LEDGER.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
552:         for number, line in enumerate(handle, 1):
553:             if not line.strip():
554:                 continue
555:             try:
556:                 row = json.loads(line)
557:             except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
558:                 return {"ok": False, "line": number, "reason": f"malformed:{exc}"}
559:             ledger_hash = str(row.pop("ledger_hash", ""))
560:             row_previous = str(row.pop("previous_hash", ""))
561:             expected = _sha256({"previous_hash": previous, "receipt": row})
562:             if row_previous != previous or ledger_hash != expected:
563:                 return {"ok": False, "line": number, "reason": "hash_chain_mismatch"}
564:             previous = ledger_hash
565:             events += 1
566:     return {
567:         "ok": True,
568:         "events": events,
569:         "head": previous,
570:         "path": str(TRIAD_LEDGER),
571:     }
572: 
573: 
574: def triad_status() -> dict[str, Any]:
575:     try:
576:         pillars = _load_pillars()
577:         descriptors = {name: module.triad_descriptor() for name, module in pillars.items()}
578:         error = None
579:     except Exception as exc:  # status reports; operations still fail closed
580:         descriptors = {}
581:         error = f"{type(exc).__name__}:{exc}"
582:     return {
583:         "contract_version": TRIAD_CONTRACT_VERSION,
584:         "pillars": descriptors,
585:         "ledger": verify_triad_ledger(),
586:         "error": error,
587:     }

250: def _acquire_lock(timeout_s: float = 5.0) -> int:
251:     TRIAD_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
252:     deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout_s
253:     while True:
254:         try:
255:             return os.open(TRIAD_LOCK, os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY)
256:         except FileExistsError:
257:             if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
258:                 raise TriadError("triad_ledger_lock_timeout")
259:             time.sleep(0.025)

262: def _release_lock(fd: int) -> None:
263:     try:
264:         os.close(fd)
265:     finally:
266:         TRIAD_LOCK.unlink(missing_ok=True)

269: def _last_ledger_hash() -> str:
270:     if not TRIAD_LEDGER.is_file():
271:         return "0" * 64
272:     last = ""
273:     with TRIAD_LEDGER.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
274:         for line in handle:
275:             if line.strip():
276:                 last = line
277:     if not last:
278:         return "0" * 64
279:     try:
280:         return str(json.loads(last).get("ledger_hash") or "0" * 64)
281:     except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
282:         raise TriadError("triad_ledger_malformed") from exc

285: def _append_receipt(receipt: TriadReceipt, *, s_n: float) -> TriadReceipt:
286:     security = _security_module()
287:     base = receipt.to_dict()
288:     base.pop("ledger_hash", None)
289:     encoded = _stable_json(base)
290:     gate = security.tool_gate(
291:         "write_file",
292:         {
293:             "path": str(TRIAD_LEDGER).replace("\\", "/"),
294:             "content_sha256": _sha256(encoded.encode("utf-8")),
295:             "bytes": len(encoded.encode("utf-8")),
296:         },
297:         s_n,
298:         forensic_buffer="AIOS Triad receipt append",
299:     )
300:     if not gate.get("allowed"):
301:         raise TriadDenied("triad_ledger_write_denied", evidence=gate)
302:     fd = _acquire_lock()
303:     try:
304:         previous = _last_ledger_hash()
305:         ledger_hash = _sha256({"previous_hash": previous, "receipt": base})
306:         row = {**base, "previous_hash": previous, "ledger_hash": ledger_hash}
307:         TRIAD_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
308:         with TRIAD_LEDGER.open("a", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as handle:
309:             handle.write(_stable_json(row) + "\n")
310:             handle.flush()
311:             os.fsync(handle.fileno())
312:     finally:
313:         _release_lock(fd)
314:     return TriadReceipt(**{**base, "ledger_hash": ledger_hash})

336:         output_sha256=_sha256(output_value) if output_value is not None else None,
337:         security=dict(security or {}),
338:         pillars=dict(pillars or {}),
339:         created_at=_utc(),

359: def open_context(

363: ) -> TriadContext:

366:     if not math.isfinite(float(ttl_s)) or not 0.0 < float(ttl_s) <= 3600.0:
367:         raise TriadDenied("invalid_context_ttl")

369:     membrane_halt = security.require_membrane()
370:     if membrane_halt:
371:         raise TriadDenied("security_membrane_unavailable", evidence=membrane_halt)

374:     if not ingress.get("allowed"):

379:     rid = dict(pillars["rid"].triad_observe(env.to_dict()))
380:     auto = dict(pillars["auto"].triad_decide(env.to_dict(), rid=rid, uml=uml))
381:     versions = {
382:         name: str(module.triad_descriptor().get("version") or "")
383:         for name, module in pillars.items()

385:     context = TriadContext(
386:         context_id=uuid.uuid4().hex,
387:         envelope=env,
388:         opened_at=_utc(),
389:         expires_monotonic=time.monotonic() + float(ttl_s),
390:         security_ingress=ingress,
391:         rid=rid,
392:         auto=auto,
393:         uml=uml,
394:         pillar_versions=versions,
395:     )

399:         context,
400:         stage="OPEN",

402:         reason="security_and_triad_allowed",

404:         security=ingress,
405:         pillars={"rid": rid, "auto": auto, "uml": uml},

410: def authorize_operation(
411:     context: TriadContext,
412:     *,

454:         reason = str(policy.get("reason") or "auto_operation_denied")
455:     else:
456:         reason = str(security_verdict.get("reason") or "security_operation_denied")
457:     receipt = _receipt(
458:         context,
459:         stage="DISPATCH",
460:         allowed=allowed,
461:         reason=reason,
462:         input_value={"operation": operation, "params": dict(params)},
463:         security=security_verdict,
464:         pillars={"auto": policy, "uml": structural, "rid": context.rid},
465:     )
466:     if not allowed:
467:         raise TriadDenied(reason, evidence=receipt.to_dict())

471: def dispatch(
472:     context: TriadContext,
473:     *,
474:     operation: str,
475:     params: Mapping[str, Any],
476:     handler: Callable[[], Any],
477:     tool_name: str | None = None,
478: ) -> tuple[Any, TriadReceipt]:
479:     """Authorize, execute, and receipt one bounded operation."""
480:     authorize_operation(
481:         context,
482:         operation=operation,
483:         params=params,
484:         tool_name=tool_name,
485:     )
486:     try:
487:         result = handler()
488:     except Exception as exc:
489:         _receipt(
490:             context,
491:             stage="EXECUTE",
492:             allowed=False,
493:             reason=f"{type(exc).__name__}:{exc}",
494:             input_value={"operation": operation, "params": dict(params)},
495:         )
496:         raise
497:     receipt = _receipt(
498:         context,
499:         stage="EXECUTE",
500:         allowed=True,
501:         reason="executed",
502:         input_value={"operation": operation, "params": dict(params)},
503:         output_value=result,
504:     )
505:     return result, receipt

508: def emit(context: TriadContext, result: Any) -> tuple[Any, TriadReceipt]:
509:     """Pass a result back through UML/AUTO/RID and Security OUT."""
510:     context.validate()
511:     pillars = _load_pillars()
512:     structural = dict(
513:         pillars["uml"].triad_validate_result(result=result, context=context.to_dict())
514:     )
515:     policy = dict(
516:         pillars["auto"].triad_authorize_egress(
517:             result=result,
518:             context=context.to_dict(),
519:             uml=structural,
520:         )
521:     )
522:     if not structural.get("allowed") or not policy.get("allowed"):
523:         reason = str(structural.get("reason") or policy.get("reason") or "pillar_egress_denied")
524:         raise TriadDenied(reason, evidence={"uml": structural, "auto": policy})
525:     text = result if isinstance(result, str) else _stable_json(result)
526:     filtered, security_verdict = _security_module().filter_egress(
527:         text, context.envelope.s_n
528:     )
529:     security_result = dict(security_verdict or {"allowed": True, "stage": "empty"})
530:     allowed = bool(security_result.get("allowed", filtered is not None))
531:     receipt = _receipt(
532:         context,
533:         stage="EMIT",
534:         allowed=allowed,
535:         reason="emitted" if allowed else str(security_result.get("reason") or "egress_denied"),
536:         input_value=result,
537:         output_value=filtered,
538:         security=security_result,
539:         pillars={"rid": context.rid, "auto": policy, "uml": structural},
540:     )
541:     if not allowed:
542:         raise TriadDenied("security_egress_denied", evidence=receipt.to_dict())
543:     return filtered, receipt

546: def verify_triad_ledger() -> dict[str, Any]:
547:     previous = "0" * 64
548:     events = 0
549:     if not TRIAD_LEDGER.is_file():
550:         return {"ok": True, "events": 0, "head": previous, "path": str(TRIAD_LEDGER)}
551:     with TRIAD_LEDGER.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
552:         for number, line in enumerate(handle, 1):
553:             if not line.strip():
554:                 continue
555:             try:
556:                 row = json.loads(line)
557:             except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
558:                 return {"ok": False, "line": number, "reason": f"malformed:{exc}"}
559:             ledger_hash = str(row.pop("ledger_hash", ""))
560:             row_previous = str(row.pop("previous_hash", ""))
561:             expected = _sha256({"previous_hash": previous, "receipt": row})
562:             if row_previous != previous or ledger_hash != expected:
563:                 return {"ok": False, "line": number, "reason": "hash_chain_mismatch"}
564:             previous = ledger_hash
565:             events += 1
566:     return {
567:         "ok": True,
568:         "events": events,
569:         "head": previous,
570:         "path": str(TRIAD_LEDGER),
571:     }
572: 
573: 
574: def triad_status() -> dict[str, Any]:
575:     try:
576:         pillars = _load_pillars()
577:         descriptors = {name: module.triad_descriptor() for name, module in pillars.items()}
578:         error = None
579:     except Exception as exc:  # status reports; operations still fail closed
580:         descriptors = {}
581:         error = f"{type(exc).__name__}:{exc}"
582:     return {
583:         "contract_version": TRIAD_CONTRACT_VERSION,
584:         "pillars": descriptors,
585:         "ledger": verify_triad_ledger(),
586:         "error": error,
587:     }

51: def _utc() -> str:

55: def _stable_json(value: Any) -> str:
56:     return json.dumps(
57:         value,
58:         sort_keys=True,
59:         separators=(",", ":"),
60:         ensure_ascii=False,
61:         default=str,

65: def _sha256(value: Any) -> str:
66:     raw = value if isinstance(value, bytes) else _stable_json(value).encode("utf-8")
67:     return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()

70: def _finite_s_n(value: Any) -> float:
71:     try:
72:         result = float(value)
73:     except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
74:         raise TriadDenied("invalid_s_n", evidence={"value": value}) from exc
75:     if not math.isfinite(result) or not 0.0 <= result <= 1.0:
76:         raise TriadDenied("invalid_s_n", evidence={"value": value})
77:     return result

80: @dataclass(frozen=True)
81: class TriadEnvelope:
82:     trace_id: str
83:     actor: str
84:     source: str
85:     target: str
86:     action: str
87:     payload: Any
88:     payload_sha256: str
89:     s_n: float
90:     contract_version: str
91:     created_at: str
92: 
93:     @classmethod
94:     def build(
95:         cls,
96:         *,
97:         actor: str,
98:         source: str,
99:         target: str,
100:         action: str,
101:         payload: Any,
102:         s_n: float,
103:         trace_id: str | None = None,
104:     ) -> "TriadEnvelope":
105:         if not all(str(value).strip() for value in (actor, source, target, action)):
106:             raise TriadDenied("missing_envelope_identity")
107:         normalized_s_n = _finite_s_n(s_n)
108:         return cls(
109:             trace_id=trace_id or uuid.uuid4().hex,
110:             actor=str(actor).strip(),
111:             source=str(source).strip(),
112:             target=str(target).strip(),
113:             action=str(action).strip().upper(),
114:             payload=payload,
115:             payload_sha256=_sha256(payload),
116:             s_n=normalized_s_n,
117:             contract_version=TRIAD_CONTRACT_VERSION,
118:             created_at=_utc(),
119:         )
120: 
121:     @classmethod
122:     def from_value(cls, value: "TriadEnvelope | Mapping[str, Any]") -> "TriadEnvelope":
123:         if isinstance(value, cls):
124:             envelope = value
125:         else:
126:             raw = dict(value)
127:             envelope = cls(
128:                 trace_id=str(raw.get("trace_id") or ""),
129:                 actor=str(raw.get("actor") or ""),
130:                 source=str(raw.get("source") or ""),
131:                 target=str(raw.get("target") or ""),
132:                 action=str(raw.get("action") or "").upper(),
133:                 payload=raw.get("payload"),
134:                 payload_sha256=str(raw.get("payload_sha256") or ""),
135:                 s_n=_finite_s_n(raw.get("s_n")),
136:                 contract_version=str(raw.get("contract_version") or ""),
137:                 created_at=str(raw.get("created_at") or ""),
138:             )
139:         envelope.validate()
140:         return envelope

142:     def validate(self) -> None:
143:         if self.contract_version != TRIAD_CONTRACT_VERSION:
144:             raise TriadDenied(
145:                 "triad_contract_version_mismatch",
146:                 evidence={
147:                     "expected": TRIAD_CONTRACT_VERSION,
148:                     "actual": self.contract_version,
149:                 },
150:             )
151:         if not all(
152:             str(value).strip()
153:             for value in (self.trace_id, self.actor, self.source, self.target, self.action)
154:         ):
155:             raise TriadDenied("malformed_envelope")
156:         _finite_s_n(self.s_n)
157:         if self.payload_sha256 != _sha256(self.payload):
158:             raise TriadDenied("payload_hash_mismatch")

160:     def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:

180:         if not self.security_ingress.get("allowed"):
181:             raise TriadDenied("security_ingress_denied", evidence=self.security_ingress)
182:         for name, verdict in (("rid", self.rid), ("auto", self.auto), ("uml", self.uml)):
183:             if not verdict.get("allowed", verdict.get("ok", False)):

185:         active = _ACTIVE_CONTEXTS.get(self.context_id)

193:             for name, module in _load_pillars().items()
194:         }
195:         if current_versions != self.pillar_versions:

197:                 "triad_pillar_version_changed",
198:                 evidence={"opened": self.pillar_versions, "current": current_versions},
199:             )

201:     def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
202:         payload = asdict(self)

207: @dataclass(frozen=True)
208: class TriadReceipt:
209:     receipt_id: str
210:     trace_id: str
211:     context_id: str
212:     stage: str
213:     allowed: bool
214:     reason: str
215:     input_sha256: str
216:     output_sha256: str | None
217:     security: dict[str, Any]
218:     pillars: dict[str, Any]
219:     created_at: str
220:     ledger_hash: str = ""
221: 
222:     def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
223:         return asdict(self)

226: def _security_module():
227:     return importlib.import_module("lib.security_membrane")

230: def _load_pillars() -> dict[str, Any]:
231:     modules: dict[str, Any] = {}
232:     for name, module_name in PILLAR_MODULES.items():
233:         module = importlib.import_module(module_name)
234:         descriptor_fn = getattr(module, "triad_descriptor", None)
235:         if descriptor_fn is None:
236:             raise TriadDenied(
237:                 "pillar_contract_missing",
238:                 evidence={"pillar": name, "module": module_name},
239:             )
240:         descriptor = dict(descriptor_fn())
241:         if descriptor.get("triad_contract_version") != TRIAD_CONTRACT_VERSION:
242:             raise TriadDenied(
243:                 "pillar_contract_version_mismatch",
244:                 evidence={"pillar": name, "descriptor": descriptor},
245:             )
246:         modules[name] = module
247:     return modules

250: def _acquire_lock(timeout_s: float = 5.0) -> int:
251:     TRIAD_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
252:     deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout_s
253:     while True:
254:         try:
255:             return os.open(TRIAD_LOCK, os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY)
256:         except FileExistsError:
257:             if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
258:                 raise TriadError("triad_ledger_lock_timeout")
259:             time.sleep(0.025)
260: 
261: 
262: def _release_lock(fd: int) -> None:
263:     try:
264:         os.close(fd)
265:     finally:
266:         TRIAD_LOCK.unlink(missing_ok=True)
267: 
268: 
269: def _last_ledger_hash() -> str:
270:     if not TRIAD_LEDGER.is_file():
271:         return "0" * 64
272:     last = ""
273:     with TRIAD_LEDGER.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
274:         for line in handle:
275:             if line.strip():
276:                 last = line
277:     if not last:
278:         return "0" * 64
279:     try:
280:         return str(json.loads(last).get("ledger_hash") or "0" * 64)
281:     except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
282:         raise TriadError("triad_ledger_malformed") from exc
283: 
284: 
285: def _append_receipt(receipt: TriadReceipt, *, s_n: float) -> TriadReceipt:
286:     security = _security_module()
287:     base = receipt.to_dict()
288:     base.pop("ledger_hash", None)
289:     encoded = _stable_json(base)
290:     gate = security.tool_gate(
291:         "write_file",
292:         {
293:             "path": str(TRIAD_LEDGER).replace("\\", "/"),
294:             "content_sha256": _sha256(encoded.encode("utf-8")),
295:             "bytes": len(encoded.encode("utf-8")),
296:         },
297:         s_n,
298:         forensic_buffer="AIOS Triad receipt append",
299:     )
300:     if not gate.get("allowed"):
301:         raise TriadDenied("triad_ledger_write_denied", evidence=gate)
302:     fd = _acquire_lock()
303:     try:
304:         previous = _last_ledger_hash()
305:         ledger_hash = _sha256({"previous_hash": previous, "receipt": base})
306:         row = {**base, "previous_hash": previous, "ledger_hash": ledger_hash}
307:         TRIAD_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
308:         with TRIAD_LEDGER.open("a", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as handle:
309:             handle.write(_stable_json(row) + "\n")
310:             handle.flush()
311:             os.fsync(handle.fileno())
312:     finally:
313:         _release_lock(fd)
314:     return TriadReceipt(**{**base, "ledger_hash": ledger_hash})

317: def _receipt(
318:     context: TriadContext,
319:     *,
320:     stage: str,
321:     allowed: bool,
322:     reason: str,
323:     input_value: Any,
324:     output_value: Any = None,
325:     security: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
326:     pillars: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
327: ) -> TriadReceipt:
328:     receipt = TriadReceipt(
329:         receipt_id=uuid.uuid4().hex,
330:         trace_id=context.envelope.trace_id,
331:         context_id=context.context_id,
332:         stage=stage,
333:         allowed=bool(allowed),
334:         reason=str(reason),
335:         input_sha256=_sha256(input_value),
336:         output_sha256=_sha256(output_value) if output_value is not None else None,
337:         security=dict(security or {}),
338:         pillars=dict(pillars or {}),
339:         created_at=_utc(),
340:     )
341:     return _append_receipt(receipt, s_n=context.envelope.s_n)

344: def _context_binding(context: TriadContext) -> str:
345:     return _sha256(
346:         {
347:             "context_id": context.context_id,
348:             "envelope": context.envelope.to_dict(),
349:             "opened_at": context.opened_at,
350:             "security_ingress": context.security_ingress,
351:             "rid": context.rid,
352:             "auto": context.auto,
353:             "uml": context.uml,
354:             "pillar_versions": context.pillar_versions,

359: def open_context(
360:     envelope: TriadEnvelope | Mapping[str, Any],
361:     *,
362:     ttl_s: float = DEFAULT_CONTEXT_TTL_S,
363: ) -> TriadContext:
364:     """Open one fail-closed Security -> RID/AUTO/UML request context."""
365:     env = TriadEnvelope.from_value(envelope)
366:     if not math.isfinite(float(ttl_s)) or not 0.0 < float(ttl_s) <= 3600.0:
367:         raise TriadDenied("invalid_context_ttl")
368:     security = _security_module()
369:     membrane_halt = security.require_membrane()
370:     if membrane_halt:
371:         raise TriadDenied("security_membrane_unavailable", evidence=membrane_halt)
372:     raw = _stable_json(env.to_dict())
373:     ingress = dict(security.ingress_gate(raw, env.s_n))
374:     if not ingress.get("allowed"):
375:         raise TriadDenied("security_ingress_denied", evidence=ingress)
376: 
377:     pillars = _load_pillars()
378:     uml = dict(pillars["uml"].triad_validate_envelope(env.to_dict()))
379:     rid = dict(pillars["rid"].triad_observe(env.to_dict()))
380:     auto = dict(pillars["auto"].triad_decide(env.to_dict(), rid=rid, uml=uml))
381:     versions = {
382:         name: str(module.triad_descriptor().get("version") or "")
383:         for name, module in pillars.items()
384:     }
385:     context = TriadContext(
386:         context_id=uuid.uuid4().hex,
387:         envelope=env,
388:         opened_at=_utc(),
389:         expires_monotonic=time.monotonic() + float(ttl_s),
390:         security_ingress=ingress,
391:         rid=rid,
392:         auto=auto,
393:         uml=uml,
394:         pillar_versions=versions,
395:     )
396:     _ACTIVE_CONTEXTS[context.context_id] = _context_binding(context)
397:     context.validate()
398:     _receipt(
399:         context,
400:         stage="OPEN",
401:         allowed=True,
402:         reason="security_and_triad_allowed",
403:         input_value=env.to_dict(),
404:         security=ingress,
405:         pillars={"rid": rid, "auto": auto, "uml": uml},
406:     )
407:     return context

410: def authorize_operation(
411:     context: TriadContext,
412:     *,
413:     operation: str,
414:     params: Mapping[str, Any],
415:     tool_name: str | None = None,
416: ) -> TriadReceipt:
417:     """Authorize one internal or external operation within an open context."""
418:     context.validate()
419:     pillars = _load_pillars()
420:     structural = dict(
421:         pillars["uml"].triad_validate_operation(
422:             operation=str(operation),
423:             params=dict(params),
424:             context=context.to_dict(),
425:         )
426:     )
427:     policy = dict(
428:         pillars["auto"].triad_authorize_capability(
429:             operation=str(operation),
430:             params=dict(params),
431:             context=context.to_dict(),
432:             uml=structural,
433:         )
434:     )
435:     security_verdict: dict[str, Any] = {"allowed": True, "stage": "internal"}
436:     if tool_name:
437:         security_verdict = dict(
438:             _security_module().tool_gate(
439:                 str(tool_name),
440:                 dict(params),
441:                 context.envelope.s_n,
442:                 forensic_buffer=f"Triad operation {operation}",
443:                 raw_input=_stable_json(context.envelope.to_dict()),
444:             )
445:         )
446:     allowed = bool(structural.get("allowed")) and bool(policy.get("allowed")) and bool(
447:         security_verdict.get("allowed")
448:     )
449:     if allowed:
450:         reason = "authorized"
451:     elif not structural.get("allowed"):
452:         reason = str(structural.get("reason") or "uml_operation_denied")
453:     elif not policy.get("allowed"):
454:         reason = str(policy.get("reason") or "auto_operation_denied")
455:     else:
456:         reason = str(security_verdict.get("reason") or "security_operation_denied")
457:     receipt = _receipt(
458:         context,
459:         stage="DISPATCH",
460:         allowed=allowed,
461:         reason=reason,
462:         input_value={"operation": operation, "params": dict(params)},
463:         security=security_verdict,
464:         pillars={"auto": policy, "uml": structural, "rid": context.rid},
465:     )
466:     if not allowed:
467:         raise TriadDenied(reason, evidence=receipt.to_dict())
468:     return receipt
469:

471: def dispatch(
472:     context: TriadContext,
473:     *,
474:     operation: str,
475:     params: Mapping[str, Any],
476:     handler: Callable[[], Any],
477:     tool_name: str | None = None,
478: ) -> tuple[Any, TriadReceipt]:
479:     """Authorize, execute, and receipt one bounded operation."""
480:     authorize_operation(
481:         context,
482:         operation=operation,
483:         params=params,
484:         tool_name=tool_name,
485:     )
486:     try:
487:         result = handler()
488:     except Exception as exc:
489:         _receipt(
490:             context,
491:             stage="EXECUTE",
492:             allowed=False,
493:             reason=f"{type(exc).__name__}:{exc}",
494:             input_value={"operation": operation, "params": dict(params)},
495:         )
496:         raise
497:     receipt = _receipt(
498:         context,
499:         stage="EXECUTE",
500:         allowed=True,
501:         reason="executed",
502:         input_value={"operation": operation, "params": dict(params)},
503:         output_value=result,
504:     )
505:     return result, receipt
506:

508: def emit(context: TriadContext, result: Any) -> tuple[Any, TriadReceipt]:
509:     """Pass a result back through UML/AUTO/RID and Security OUT."""
510:     context.validate()
511:     pillars = _load_pillars()
512:     structural = dict(
513:         pillars["uml"].triad_validate_result(result=result, context=context.to_dict())
514:     )
515:     policy = dict(
516:         pillars["auto"].triad_authorize_egress(
517:             result=result,
518:             context=context.to_dict(),
519:             uml=structural,
520:         )
521:     )
522:     if not structural.get("allowed") or not policy.get("allowed"):
523:         reason = str(structural.get("reason") or policy.get("reason") or "pillar_egress_denied")
524:         raise TriadDenied(reason, evidence={"uml": structural, "auto": policy})
525:     text = result if isinstance(result, str) else _stable_json(result)
526:     filtered, security_verdict = _security_module().filter_egress(
527:         text, context.envelope.s_n
528:     )
529:     security_result = dict(security_verdict or {"allowed": True, "stage": "empty"})
530:     allowed = bool(security_result.get("allowed", filtered is not None))
531:     receipt = _receipt(
532:         context,
533:         stage="EMIT",
534:         allowed=allowed,
535:         reason="emitted" if allowed else str(security_result.get("reason") or "egress_denied"),
536:         input_value=result,
537:         output_value=filtered,
538:         security=security_result,
539:         pillars={"rid": context.rid, "auto": policy, "uml": structural},
540:     )
541:     if not allowed:
542:         raise TriadDenied("security_egress_denied", evidence=receipt.to_dict())
543:     return filtered, receipt
544:

546: def verify_triad_ledger() -> dict[str, Any]:
547:     previous = "0" * 64
548:     events = 0
549:     if not TRIAD_LEDGER.is_file():
550:         return {"ok": True, "events": 0, "head": previous, "path": str(TRIAD_LEDGER)}
551:     with TRIAD_LEDGER.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
552:         for number, line in enumerate(handle, 1):
553:             if not line.strip():
554:                 continue
555:             try:
556:                 row = json.loads(line)
557:             except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
558:                 return {"ok": False, "line": number, "reason": f"malformed:{exc}"}
559:             ledger_hash = str(row.pop("ledger_hash", ""))
560:             row_previous = str(row.pop("previous_hash", ""))
561:             expected = _sha256({"previous_hash": previous, "receipt": row})
562:             if row_previous != previous or ledger_hash != expected:
563:                 return {"ok": False, "line": number, "reason": "hash_chain_mismatch"}
564:             previous = ledger_hash
565:             events += 1
566:     return {
567:         "ok": True,
568:         "events": events,
569:         "head": previous,
570:         "path": str(TRIAD_LEDGER),
571:     }
572: 
573: 
574: def triad_status() -> dict[str, Any]:
575:     try:
576:         pillars = _load_pillars()
577:         descriptors = {name: module.triad_descriptor() for name, module in pillars.items()}
578:         error = None
579:     except Exception as exc:  # status reports; operations still fail closed
580:         descriptors = {}
581:         error = f"{type(exc).__name__}:{exc}"
582:     return {
583:         "contract_version": TRIAD_CONTRACT_VERSION,
584:         "pillars": descriptors,
585:         "ledger": verify_triad_ledger(),
586:         "error": error,
587:     }

471: def dispatch(

475:     params: Mapping[str, Any],

478: ) -> tuple[Any, TriadReceipt]:

481:         context,

483:         params=params,
484:         tool_name=tool_name,
485:     )
486:     try:
487:         result = handler()
488:     except Exception as exc:
489:         _receipt(
490:             context,

492:             allowed=False,
493:             reason=f"{type(exc).__name__}:{exc}",
494:             input_value={"operation": operation, "params": dict(params)},
495:         )
496:         raise
497:     receipt = _receipt(
498:         context,
499:         stage="EXECUTE",
500:         allowed=True,
501:         reason="executed",
502:         input_value={"operation": operation, "params": dict(params)},
503:         output_value=result,
504:     )

514:     )
515:     policy = dict(
516:         pillars["auto"].triad_authorize_egress(
517:             result=result,
518:             context=context.to_dict(),
519:             uml=structural,
520:         )
521:     )
522:     if not structural.get("allowed") or not policy.get("allowed"):
523:         reason = str(structural.get("reason") or policy.get("reason") or "pillar_egress_denied")
524:         raise TriadDenied(reason, evidence={"uml": structural, "auto": policy})
525:     text = result if isinstance(result, str) else _stable_json(result)
526:     filtered, security_verdict = _security_module().filter_egress(
527:         text, context.envelope.s_n
528:     )
529:     security_result = dict(security_verdict or {"allowed": True, "stage": "empty"})
530:     allowed = bool(security_result.get("allowed", filtered is not None))
531:     receipt = _receipt(
532:         context,
533:         stage="EMIT",
534:         allowed=allowed,
535:         reason="emitted" if allowed else str(security_result.get("reason") or "egress_denied"),
536:         input_value=result,
537:         output_value=filtered,
538:         security=security_result,
539:         pillars={"rid": context.rid, "auto": policy, "uml": structural},
540:     )
541:     if not allowed:
542:         raise TriadDenied("security_egress_denied", evidence=receipt.to_dict())
543:     return filtered, receipt
544: 
545: 
546: def verify_triad_ledger() -> dict[str, Any]:
547:     previous = "0" * 64
548:     events = 0
549:     if not TRIAD_LEDGER.is_file():
550:         return {"ok": True, "events": 0, "head": previous, "path": str(TRIAD_LEDGER)}
551:     with TRIAD_LEDGER.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
552:         for number, line in enumerate(handle, 1):
553:             if not line.strip():
554:                 continue
555:             try:
556:                 row = json.loads(line)
557:             except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
558:                 return {"ok": False, "line": number, "reason": f"malformed:{exc}"}
559:             ledger_hash = str(row.pop("ledger_hash", ""))
560:             row_previous = str(row.pop("previous_hash", ""))
561:             expected = _sha256({"previous_hash": previous, "receipt": row})
562:             if row_previous != previous or ledger_hash != expected:
563:                 return {"ok": False, "line": number, "reason": "hash_chain_mismatch"}
564:             previous = ledger_hash
565:             events += 1
566:     return {
567:         "ok": True,
568:         "events": events,
569:         "head": previous,
570:         "path": str(TRIAD_LEDGER),
571:     }
572: 
573: 
574: def triad_status() -> dict[str, Any]:
575:     try:
576:         pillars = _load_pillars()
577:         descriptors = {name: module.triad_descriptor() for name, module in pillars.items()}
578:         error = None
579:     except Exception as exc:  # status reports; operations still fail closed
580:         descriptors = {}
581:         error = f"{type(exc).__name__}:{exc}"
582:     return {
583:         "contract_version": TRIAD_CONTRACT_VERSION,
584:         "pillars": descriptors,
585:         "ledger": verify_triad_ledger(),
586:         "error": error,
587:     }
